website_content.title: JNVST Class 9 & 11 Lateral Entry Selection Test (LEST) 2027-28
website_content.summary: Navodaya Vidyalaya Samiti (NVS) invites online applications for lateral entry admission to Class 9 and Class 11 for the 2027-28 academic session. The application window closes on September 30, 2026.
website_content.markdown_content:
## Overview
The **Navodaya Vidyalaya Samiti (NVS)**, under the Ministry of Education, has announced the Jawahar Navodaya Vidyalaya Selection Test (JNVST) Lateral Entry Selection Test (LEST) 2027. This is a prime opportunity for students to secure admission into premier residential schools.

## Important Dates
* **Online Application Start:** September 2, 2026
* **Application Deadline:** September 30, 2026
* **Correction Window:** October 1 to October 3, 2026
* **LEST 2027 Exam Date:** April 10, 2027

## Eligibility Criteria
* **For Class 9 Admission:** Students currently studying in **Class 8** in a government or government-recognized school.
* **For Class 11 Admission:** Students currently studying in **Class 10** in a government or government-recognized school.
* **District Domicile:** Applicants must be studying in the same district as the JNV they are applying to.

## Application Process
* **Registration:** Visit the official NVS portal and register for the respective class.
* **Details:** Fill in basic personal, academic, and communication details.
* **Documents:** Upload photograph, candidate signature, parent signature, and category/UDID certificate (if applicable).
* **Verification:** Preview the application and submit before the deadline.
* **Confirmation:** Download and print the registration slip for future reference.

## Key Instructions
* Ensure the **Date of Birth** matches school records exactly.
* Use an active mobile number and email for admit card and result notifications.
* Refer to the official NVS prospectus for legal eligibility and procedural details.

website_content.title: Jharkhand NEET UG Counselling 2026 State Merit List Correction Notice
website_content.summary: JCECEB has released Advt. No. 77 regarding corrections in the State Merit List for MBBS, BDS, and BHMS state-quota admissions. Candidates must verify their details to ensure a smooth counselling process.
website_content.markdown_content:
## Overview
The Jharkhand Combined Entrance Competitive Examination Board (JCECEB) has published an official notice (**Advt. No. 77**) dated **1 September 2026** concerning corrections in the State Merit List for NEET (UG)-2026.

## Applicable Courses
This notice is critical for candidates seeking admission in the following courses under the Jharkhand State Quota:
* **MBBS**
* **BDS**
* **BHMS**

## Who Should Check This Notice?
Candidates must review the list if they fall into these categories:
* Registered candidates for the Jharkhand NEET UG 2026 State Merit List.
* Candidates who suspect errors in their **Name, Category, Roll Number, or Score**.
* Those currently participating in or awaiting the state counselling rounds.

## How to Verify and Raise Corrections
1. Visit the official JCECEB portal.
2. Navigate to the **Notices** section and select **Counselling Notices**.
3. Locate **Advt. No. 77 dated 01.09.2026**.
4. Download the PDF and follow the specific submission method and deadline mentioned therein.

## Important Instructions
* **Verify Directly:** Always rely on the official PDF for deadlines, as schedules are frequently revised.
* **Keep Documents Ready:** Have your NEET (UG) 2026 roll number and registration details available before requesting corrections.

website_content.title: Balrampur Anganwadi Worker & Helper Recruitment 2026
website_content.summary: Recruitment for 495 posts of Anganwadi Karyakatri (Worker) and Sahayika (Helper) by the District Programme Officer, Balrampur. Eligible women candidates must apply online by September 23, 2026.
website_content.markdown_content:
## Balrampur Anganwadi Recruitment 2026

The Office of the District Programme Officer (Child Development), Balrampur has announced vacancies for **Anganwadi Workers (Karyakatri)** and **Helpers (Sahayika)** on an honorarium basis.

### 📊 Vacancy Details
* **Total Posts:** 495
* **Anganwadi Karyakatri:** 236 Posts
* **Anganwadi Sahayika:** 259 Posts
* **Distribution:** Spread across 11 Child Development Projects in Balrampur district.

### 📅 Important Dates
* **Notification Date:** 02 September 2026
* **Last Date to Apply:** 23 September 2026
* **Age Cut-off Date:** 01 July 2026

### 🎓 Eligibility Criteria
* **Gender:** Women candidates only.
* **Education:** Minimum **Intermediate (12th)** or equivalent. Higher qualifications (up to PG) are eligible and will be considered for merit.
* **Age Limit:** 18 to 35 years.

### 🛠️ Selection & Preference Process
Selection for Karyakatri posts follows a strict priority order within the same Gram Sabha/Ward:
1. **BPL Group:** Widows $ightarrow$ Divorced/Deserted $ightarrow$ Other BPL women.
2. **APL Group:** Widows $ightarrow$ Divorced/Deserted $ightarrow$ Other APL women.

### 📝 Application Guidelines
* **Mode:** Online only via the official portal.
* **Documents Required:** Digitally signed residence, caste, and income certificates. Widow/Divorced candidates must upload relevant legal death certificates or court orders.
* **Restriction:** Two women from the same family cannot be appointed to the same Anganwadi centre.

website_content.title: Kerala University UG & PG Degree Results 2026
website_content.summary: Kerala University has released the results for various Undergraduate and Postgraduate degree examinations on September 2nd and 3rd, 2026. Students of MSW, B.Com, BA, MA, M.Com, and B.P.Ed can now download their mark lists.
website_content.markdown_content:
## Result Overview
Kerala University has officially published the results for multiple UG and PG courses. The results are released as consolidated PDF mark lists for various semesters.

## List of Published Results
* **MSW Disaster Management**: Fourth Semester PG Degree Exam (Supplementary) - Published Sept 3
* **B.Com Hearing Impaired**: Eighth Semester Degree Exam (Regular & Supplementary) - Published Sept 3
* **B.A (SDE)**: First and Second Semester Degree Exam - Published Sept 2
* **M.A Dance (Kerala Nadanam)**: First Semester PG Degree Exam (Regular & Supplementary) - Published Sept 2
* **M.Com**: First Semester Postgraduate Degree Exam (Regular & Supplementary) - Published Sept 2
* **B.P.Ed (2022 Scheme)**: Sixth Semester Degree Exam (Regular & Supplementary) - Published Sept 2

## Step-by-Step Guide to Check Results
1. Visit the official Kerala University examination portal.
2. Click on the **Results** tab in the top menu.
3. Locate your specific examination name and semester from the list.
4. Click the result link to open the **PDF mark list**.
5. Use the search function (**Ctrl+F**) to locate your register number within the document.

## Important Instructions
* Ensure you cross-verify your register number and name carefully.
* These results are provided as bulk PDF lists rather than individual look-up pages.
* For any discrepancies in marks, contact the university examination section via official channels.

website_content.title: AP PGCET 2026 Counselling Registration
website_content.summary: The Commissionerate of Higher Education, AP, has opened registration for AP PGCET 2026 counselling for admission into 150+ PG programmes. Eligible candidates must register via the CAP portal by September 8, 2026.
website_content.markdown_content:
## AP PGCET 2026-27 Counselling Overview

The Commissionerate of Higher Education, Government of Andhra Pradesh (APSCHE), has officially opened the counselling process for candidates who qualified in the **AP PGCET 2026** exam. This process facilitates admission into postgraduate programmes across various state universities.

## Key Highlights
* **Participating Institutions:** 17 state universities, their constituent/affiliated colleges, and eligible private universities.
* **Courses Available:** Over **150+ postgraduate (PG) programmes**.
* **Seat Allotment:** Based on PGCET rank, reservation category, local area status, and candidate web options.

## Important Dates
* **Notification Release:** September 1, 2026
* **Registration Start Date:** September 3, 2026
* **Registration End Date:** September 8, 2026

## Step-by-Step Application Process
1. **Login:** Access the CAP portal using your Hall Ticket Number and Date of Birth.
2. **Verification:** Review personal, academic, and rank details.
3. **Documentation:** Upload scanned certificates if automatic verification is unavailable.
4. **Payment:** Pay the non-refundable processing fee via UPI, Debit/Credit Card, or Net Banking.
5. **Submission:** Submit the form and download the confirmation slip.

## Allotment Workflow
* Online Registration $\rightarrow$ Certificate Verification $\rightarrow$ Web Options Entry $\rightarrow$ Seat Allotment $\rightarrow$ Self-Reporting at College.

website_content.title: UPSSSC Computer Operator & Assistant Computer Operator Recruitment 2026
website_content.summary: UPSSSC invites applications for Computer Operator Grade-A and Assistant Computer Operator posts at the Advocate General's Office, Allahabad High Court. Eligible PET-2025 candidates must apply by September 28, 2026.
website_content.markdown_content:
## Recruitment Overview
UPSSSC has released Advertisement No. 20-Pariksha/2026 for technical positions within the Office of the Advocate General, Allahabad High Court. These are temporary positions selected via a Main Examination based on PET-2025 merit.

## Vacancy Details
* **Computer Operator Grade-A:** 11 Posts (Level-4)
* **Assistant Computer Operator:** 01 Post (Level-2)
* **Total Vacancies:** 12

## Eligibility Criteria
* **Mandatory:** Must have appeared in **PET-2025** and possess a valid score card.
* **Education (Both Posts):** Bachelor's degree from a recognized university AND a Diploma in Computer Science or NIELIT 'O' Level certificate.
* **Experience:** 
    * Grade-A: 3 years of experience in computer applications.
    * Assistant: 2 years of experience in computer applications.
* **Age Limit:** 21 to 40 years (as of July 1, 2026). Age relaxation applies as per government norms.

## Important Dates
* **Application Start Date:** 07 September 2026
* **Application Deadline:** 28 September 2026
* **Correction Window Closes:** 05 October 2026

## Salary Structure
* **Computer Operator Grade-A:** ₹25,500 – ₹81,100 (Grade Pay ₹2,400)
* **Assistant Computer Operator:** ₹19,900 – ₹63,200 (Grade Pay ₹1,900)

## Selection Process
Shortlisting will be done based on normalized **PET-2025 scores** (15 times the vacancies per category). Shortlisted candidates will appear for a written Main Examination.

website_content.title: Maharashtra B.Ed CAP Round 1 Seat Allotment Result 2026
website_content.summary: The State CET Cell, Maharashtra, will release the B.Ed CAP Round 1 Seat Allotment results on September 4, 2026. Allotted candidates must report to their respective institutes between September 7 and September 10, 2026.
website_content.markdown_content:
## Maharashtra B.Ed CAP Round 1 Seat Allotment 2026

The **State Common Entrance Test (CET) Cell, Maharashtra** is scheduled to announce the seat allotment for the first round of the Centralized Admission Process (CAP) for B.Ed admissions.

### 📅 Important Dates
* **Result Declaration:** September 4, 2026 (Expected)
* **Institute Reporting & Confirmation:** September 7 to September 10, 2026 (10:00 AM to 5:00 PM)
* **College Data Upload:** September 11, 2026
* **Round 2 Vacant Seat Matrix:** September 11, 2026 (Expected)

### 🔑 How to Check Your Allotment Status
1. Visit the official portal: **bedcap26.mahacet.org**
2. Navigate to the **'Candidate Login'** section.
3. Enter your **Application ID** and **Password**.
4. View your allotted college, subject methodology, and seat category.
5. Download and print the **Allotment Letter** for reporting.

### ⚙️ Understanding 'Freeze' vs 'Betterment'
Candidates must choose one of the following options on the portal:

* **Freeze:** You accept the allotted seat as final. You must pay the acceptance fee and report to the college. You will not participate in further rounds.
* **Betterment (Not Freeze):** Available for those allotted Preference 2 or below. You keep the current seat provisionally while trying for a higher preference in Round 2.

### ⚠️ Critical Instructions
* **Self-Freeze:** Allotment of Preference 1 triggers an automatic self-freeze.
* **Documentation:** Ensure all original documents are ready for reporting between Sept 7-10.
* **Payment:** Complete the Seat Acceptance Fee payment promptly to secure your seat.

website_content.summary: Savitribai Phule Pune University (SPPU) has officially released the MBA First and Second Year Summer Session 2026 results. Students can now download their provisional marksheets using their seat numbers.
website_content.markdown_content:
## SPPU MBA Result 2026 Overview
Savitribai Phule Pune University (SPPU) has declared the results for the **MBA (2019 Revised) Summer Session 2026 (N+2+1)** for both First Year and Second Year students on **2 September 2026**.

### Key Result Details
* **University:** Savitribai Phule Pune University (SPPU)
* **Course:** MBA First Year & Second Year (2019 Revised)
* **Session:** Summer Session 2026 (N+2+1)
* **Result Date:** 2 September 2026
* **Document Type:** Provisional Marksheet

### Steps to Check Result
1. Visit the official SPPU result portal.
2. Ensure **JavaScript is enabled** in your browser for the dashboard to load.
3. Select **'Summer Session 2026'** from the session dropdown.
4. Choose the applicable course: **'First Year MBA'** or **'Second Year MBA'**.
5. Enter your **Seat Number** (and Mother's Name/PRN if prompted).
6. Click submit to view and download the PDF marksheet.

### Important Instructions
* The online marksheet is **provisional**; original copies will be issued via your respective colleges.
* Verify your **name, seat number, and marks** immediately after downloading.
* Report any discrepancies to the college or SPPU examination department before the correction deadline.

website_content.title: UPSC CDS 2 Admit Card 2026 - Download Link & Exam Date
website_content.summary: The Union Public Service Commission (UPSC) is releasing the e-Admit cards for the Combined Defence Services Examination (II), 2026 for 451 vacancies across IMA, INA, AFA, and OTA.
website_content.markdown_content:
## Examination Overview
* **Exam Name:** Combined Defence Services Examination (II), 2026
* **Conducting Body:** Union Public Service Commission (UPSC)
* **Total Vacancies:** 451 posts (IMA, INA, AFA, OTA)
* **Written Exam Date:** 13 September 2026 (Sunday)

## Important Dates
* **Application Start Date:** 20 May 2026
* **Application End Date:** 11 June 2026
* **Admit Card Release:** Expected between 3-4 September 2026
* **Exam Date:** 13 September 2026

## Steps to Download e-Admit Card
1. Visit the official UPSC website.
2. Navigate to the **Examinations** tab and select **Admit Cards**.
3. Click the link for **Combined Defence Services Examination (II), 2026**.
4. Log in using your **Registration ID or Roll Number** and **Date of Birth**.
5. Submit the captcha and download the admit card.
6. Take a printout on plain white paper.

## Mandatory Documents for Exam Day
* **Printed e-Admit Card:** Carrying two copies is highly recommended.
* **Photo ID Proof:** A valid original ID matching the registration details.
* **Specific Instructions:** Any additional documents mentioned on the admit card.

## Key Exam Day Instructions
* **Stationery:** Use only a **black ballpoint pen** for the OMR answer sheet.
* **Prohibited Items:** Mobile phones, Bluetooth devices, smartwatches, and calculators are strictly banned.
* **Reporting:** Reach the venue well before the reporting time to avoid issues.
* **Verification:** If there is any discrepancy in your name, photo, or centre, contact UPSC immediately before the exam.

website_content.title: Thane DC Aaple Sarkar Seva Kendra Recruitment 2026
website_content.summary: The District Collector Office, Thane is inviting applications for 381 Village Level Entrepreneurs (VLE) to operate Aaple Sarkar Seva Kendras in rural areas. Online applications are open from August 20 to September 20, 2026.
website_content.markdown_content:
## Overview
The **District Collector & District Magistrate Office, Thane** is seeking eligible candidates to operate **Aaple Sarkar Seva Kendras** at 381 vacant rural locations. This is an opportunity for **Village Level Entrepreneurs (VLE)** to provide citizen services; please note this is not a salaried government position.

## Important Dates
* **Online Application Start:** 20 August 2026
* **Online Application End:** 20 September 2026
* **Physical Submission Deadline:** 22 September 2026 (during office hours)

## Vacancy Distribution
| Taluka | Vacant Kendras |
| :--- | :--- |
| Kalyan | 115 |
| Bhiwandi | 111 |
| Murbad | 76 |
| Shahapur | 48 |
| Ambernath | 27 |
| Thane | 4 |
| **Total** | **381** |

## Eligibility Criteria
* **Age:** Minimum 18 years.
* **Education:** Passed Higher Secondary School Certificate (12th/HSC).
* **Skills:** Basic computer knowledge (MSCIT or equivalent preferred); Proficiency in Marathi and English.
* **Residency:** Must be a local resident of the concerned Gram Panchayat area applied for.
* **Documents:** Must possess Aadhaar, PAN, and a valid bank account.

## Infrastructure Requirements
Applicants must provide the following at the center:
* Minimum **100 sq. ft.** office space.
* Two computers/laptops, Laser printer, Scanner, Biometric device, and Webcam.
* UPS/Power backup and Broadband internet (10-20 Mbps).
* CCTV system and a dedicated citizen waiting area.

## Selection Process
Selection is based on a **100-mark evaluation** system:
* **Education & IT Literacy:** 25 Marks
* **Infrastructure & Finance:** 25 Marks
* **Experience & Business Plan:** 15 Marks
* **Interview & Communication:** 20 Marks
* **Social Inclusiveness & Character:** 20 Marks

**Selection Stages:** Scrutiny $ightarrow$ Document Verification $ightarrow$ Physical Inspection $ightarrow$ Police Verification $ightarrow$ Interview $ightarrow$ Merit List $ightarrow$ Probation.

website_content.title: Latur DC Aaple Sarkar Seva Kendra Recruitment 2026
website_content.summary: District Collector Office, Latur invites online applications for 640 Aaple Sarkar Seva Kendra Operator positions across the district. Eligible candidates must be 12th pass and local residents of the applied area.
website_content.markdown_content:
## Overview
The **District Collector Office, Latur (e-Governance Department)** has released a notification to appoint operators for **640 vacant Aaple Sarkar Seva Kendra** locations. This is a prime opportunity for local residents to operate government service centers within their own talukas and wards.

## Important Dates
* **Application Start Date:** 25 August 2026, 11:00 AM
* **Application Deadline:** 15 September 2026, 5:00 PM
* **Mode of Application:** Online Only

## Eligibility Criteria
* **Age:** Minimum 18 years
* **Education:** Passed Higher Secondary School Certificate (12th/HSC)
* **Technical Skills:** Basic computer knowledge (MSCIT or CCC certificates are preferred)
* **Residency:** Must be a **local resident** of the specific Gram Panchayat, Nagar Parishad, or Municipal Corporation ward applied for.
* **Other Requirements:** Must possess Aadhaar, PAN, and a bank account; no criminal record.

## Vacancy Distribution
* **Gram Panchayat Areas:** 599
* **Nagar Parishad / Nagar Panchayat:** 10
* **Latur City Municipal Corporation:** 31
* **Total Vacancies:** 640

## Selection Process (Total 100 Marks)
Selection is based on a merit-based evaluation conducted by the District-level Setu Committee:
* **Education:** 10 Marks
* **Computer Literacy:** 15 Marks
* **Infrastructure Facility:** 15 Marks
* **Financial Capacity:** 10 Marks
* **Interview/Communication:** 20 Marks
* **Experience:** 10 Marks
* **Business Plan:** 5 Marks
* **Social Inclusiveness:** 5 Marks
* **Character Verification:** 10 Marks

## Application Fee
* **Fee:** Rs. 500/-
* **Payment Mode:** Online via QR code (payment receipt must be uploaded with the application).

## Required Documents
* Domicile/Residence certificate from concerned local authority
* Age proof (TC/School leaving certificate)
* Aadhaar Card & PAN Card
* Educational & MSCIT/CCC certificates
* 6-month bank account statement
* Police Character Certificate (or acknowledgement receipt)
* GPS-enabled photos of the proposed office premises (interior and exterior)
* Ownership documents or Rent Agreement for the office (min. 100 sq. ft.)

website_content.markdown_content:
## GMC KB Asifabad Recruitment 2026

Government Medical College, Kumuram Bheem Asifabad, Telangana, has announced recruitment for **99 faculty positions** on a contract and honorarium basis. This is a high-paying opportunity for medical professionals registered with the Telangana State Medical Council.

### 📌 Post Details & Vacancies
* **Professor:** 15 Posts
* **Associate Professor:** 26 Posts
* **Assistant Professor:** 34 Posts
* **Senior Resident:** 24 Posts

### 💰 Consolidated Remuneration
* **Professor:** ₹1,90,000 per month
* **Associate Professor:** ₹1,50,000 per month
* **Assistant Professor:** ₹1,25,000 per month
* **Senior Resident:** ₹1,06,461 per month

### 🎓 Eligibility Criteria
* **Medical Faculty:** Candidates must possess MBBS and a postgraduate degree (MD/MS/DNB) in the relevant specialty.
* **Non-Medical Faculty:** MSc in the relevant subject with a PhD.
* **Registration:** All candidates **must be registered** with the Telangana State Medical Council.
* **Experience:** Teaching and research experience as per NMC TEQ Regulation 2025.

### 📅 Walk-In Interview Schedule
* **Date:** 11-09-2026
* **Time:** 11:00 AM to 3:00 PM
* **Venue:** Office of the Principal, Government Medical College, Kumuram Bheem Asifabad

### ⚠️ Important Instructions
* **No Online Application:** Candidates must appear in person with a filled application form downloaded from the official website.
* **Documents Required:** Aadhar/PAN, DOB proof, Degree certificates, Registration certificates, and Experience/Publication proofs.
* **Nature of Job:** Contractual appointment until 31-03-2027 or until regular posts are filled.

website_content.summary: Tourism Corporation of Gujarat Limited (TCGL) is hiring for 47 outsourced positions across 29 different posts. Walk-in interviews are scheduled for September 7th and 8th, 2026, in Gandhinagar and Ayodhya.
website_content.markdown_content:
## TCGL Recruitment 2026 Overview
Tourism Corporation of Gujarat Limited (TCGL), a Government of Gujarat undertaking, is inviting eligible candidates for various technical and administrative positions on a **purely outsourced basis** via Ethos HR Management & Projects Limited.

## 📅 Important Interview Dates & Venues

| Interview Type | Date | Venue |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Technical Posts** | 07-09-2026 | TCGL, Block No. 16/17, 4th Floor, Udhyogbhavan, Sector 11, Gandhinagar |
| **Administrative Posts** | 08-09-2026 | TCGL, Block No. 16/17, 4th Floor, Udhyogbhavan, Sector 11, Gandhinagar |
| **Project Engineer (Ayodhya)** | 07-09-2026 | Tourist Information Bureau, TCGL, Plot No. 4106/4110, Civil Lines, Ayodhya Cantt |

**⚠️ Important:** Registration at the venue is mandatory from **9:30 AM to 11:30 AM** on the day of the interview.

## 💼 Post-Wise Details & Eligibility

### 🛠 Technical Roles (Interview: 07-09-2026)
* **Project Engineer (Ayodhya):** B.E./B.Tech (3yrs exp) OR Diploma Civil (6yrs exp). Salary: **₹55,000**
* **Associate Manager:** B.E./B.Tech Civil (7yrs exp) OR Diploma Civil (9yrs exp). Salary: **₹35,000**
* **Sr. Associate Engineer:** B.E./B.Tech Civil (5yrs exp) OR Diploma Civil (7yrs exp). Salary: **₹30,000**
* **Associate Engineer:** B.E./B.Tech Civil (3yrs exp) OR Diploma Civil (5yrs exp). Salary: **₹25,000**
* **Associate Supervisor:** B.E./B.Tech Civil (1yr exp) OR Diploma Civil (3yrs exp). Salary: **₹18,000**

### 🏢 Administrative & Specialized Roles (Interview: 08-09-2026)
* **Executives/Sr. Executives:** MBA, PG Degree, or Bachelor's in Travel/Tourism/Hotel Management. Salary: **₹25,000 - ₹30,000**
* **Office Assistants:** B.Com/BBA/Any Graduate with relevant experience. Salary: **₹18,000**
* **IT Professionals:** MCA/M.Sc-IT/B.E./B.Tech in ICT. Salary: **₹18,000 - ₹30,000**
* **Legal:** LLB/LLM with experience. Salary: **₹25,000 - ₹30,000**
* **HR/Admin:** English Steno Gr. 1, Consultants, and Office Assistants. Salary: **₹18,000 - ₹25,000**

## 📄 Documents Required
Candidates must bring the following in **original and self-attested photocopies**:
* Updated CV/Resume and recent passport-size photograph.
* Educational and experience certificates.
* Valid Photo ID and Address Proof.
* Marriage certificate/Affidavit (for female candidates with surname changes).

## 🚀 How to Attend
1. Verify eligibility via the official recruitment agency website.
2. Prepare all listed documents.
3. Report to the assigned venue at **9:30 AM** for mandatory registration.

website_content.summary: Dr. NTR University of Health Sciences (NTRUHS) has released the Round 1 seat allotment for MBBS and BDS under the 85% state quota for the 2026-27 session. Allotted candidates must download their allotment letters and report to their respective colleges.
website_content.markdown_content:
## Overview
The **Dr. NTR University of Health Sciences (NTRUHS)** has officially announced the Round 1 seat allotment results for the AP NEET UG 2026 counselling process. This allotment covers seats for **MBBS and BDS** courses under the 85% state quota for the academic session 2026-27.

## Important Dates
* **Round 1 Result Date:** September 2, 2026
* **Management/Competent Authority Quota Registration:** September 2 to September 6, 2026
* **Registration Window (State Quota):** August 5 to August 12, 2026 (Completed)
* **Web Option Window:** August 29 to September 1, 2026 (Completed)

## How to Check the Result
1. Visit the official NTRUHS portal.
2. Go to the **Admission** section and select the Round 1 seat allotment link.
3. Open the result PDF and search for your **Name, Roll Number, or Rank** using Ctrl+F.
4. Verify your allotted college, course, and category.

## Post-Allotment Mandatory Steps
* **Download Allotment Letter:** Candidates must log in with their NEET UG roll number to download the individual allotment letter.
* **Document Preparation:** Gather all original certificates and multiple photocopies for verification.
* **College Reporting:** Report to the allotted institution within the prescribed deadline to secure the seat. Failure to report may lead to seat cancellation.

## Allotment Basis
Seats have been allotted based on **NEET UG 2026 rank**, category, web options filled by candidates, and seat availability.

website_content.title: UP NEET UG Counselling 2026 Round 1 Seat Matrix Released
website_content.summary: DGME Uttar Pradesh has released the Round 1 seat matrix for MBBS and BDS courses. Candidates must complete their choice filling and locking by September 5, 2026.
website_content.markdown_content:
## Overview
The **Directorate General of Medical Education and Training (DGME), Uttar Pradesh** has officially released the seat matrix for Round 1 of the UP NEET UG 2026 Counselling. This matrix provides a detailed list of vacant seats in government, private, and minority medical and dental colleges across the state.

## Important Dates
* **Seat Matrix Release:** September 2, 2026
* **Choice Filling & Locking:** September 2, 2026 (5:00 PM) to September 5, 2026 (5:00 PM)
* **Seat Allotment Result:** September 7, 2026

## Counselling Process
1. **Registration:** Online registration via the official portal.
2. **Verification:** Document upload and payment of security fees.
3. **Selection:** Review the **Seat Matrix** to identify preferred colleges.
4. **Locking:** Fill and lock choices within the stipulated deadline.
5. **Allotment:** Seat allotment based on NEET rank, category, and preferences.
6. **Reporting:** Download the allotment letter and report to the assigned college.

## Key Instructions for Candidates
* **Verify Data:** Always use the official PDF for seat counts; avoid third-party estimates.
* **Finality of Choice:** Once choices are locked after the deadline, they cannot be edited.
* **Stay Updated:** Regularly check the official portal for any revisions in the schedule.

website_content.title: MCC NEET UG 2026 Round 2 Counselling Registration
website_content.summary: The Medical Counselling Committee (MCC) has opened registration for NEET UG 2026 Round 2 counselling for AIQ, Deemed, Central Universities, AIIMS, and JIPMER. Eligible candidates can register between September 3 and September 8, 2026.
website_content.markdown_content:
## Overview
The **Medical Counselling Committee (MCC)** has released the schedule for **NEET UG 2026 Round 2**. This process covers 15% All India Quota (AIQ) seats, as well as 100% of seats in Deemed/Central Universities, AFMC, AIIMS, and JIPMER. Parallel counselling for 85% State Quota seats is also conducted.

## Important Dates
* **Online Registration & Fee Payment:** September 3 to 8, 2026 (Reg up to 3 PM, Fee up to 6 PM on Sept 8)
* **Choice Filling:** September 3 to 9, 2026
* **Choice Locking:** September 8 (4:00 PM) to September 9 (Morning)
* **Seat Allotment Result:** September 11, 2026
* **Reporting/Joining at Institute:** September 12 to 18, 2026
* **Institute Verification:** September 19, 2026

## Eligibility Criteria
Candidates are eligible for Round 2 if they fall into these categories:
* Qualified NEET UG 2026 and did not participate in Round 1.
* Participated in Round 1 but were not allotted any seat.
* Allotted a seat in Round 1 under the **"Float"** option and seeking an upgrade.
* **Note:** Candidates who chose **"Freeze"** in Round 1 are NOT eligible for Round 2.

## Step-by-Step Application Process
1. Visit the official MCC portal.
2. Select the **"UG Medical Counselling"** link.
3. New candidates click "New Registration"; Float candidates log in with existing IDs.
4. Enter personal, educational, and NEET UG result details.
5. Upload scanned photograph and signature.
6. Pay the registration fee and security deposit online.
7. Fill and lock your college/course preferences within the specified window.

## Critical Instructions
* **Freeze vs Float:** Selecting 'Freeze' exits the process; 'Float' allows for Round 2 upgrades while keeping the Round 1 seat as backup.
* **Reporting Deadline:** Failure to report by September 18 may result in forfeiture of the seat and security deposit.
* **Round 3 Limit:** Resignation from AIQ/Deemed seats is not permitted once allotted in Round 3.

website_content.summary: KEA has opened the Round 2 option entry for lateral entry admission into B.E./B.Tech and Architecture courses for diploma holders. The process commenced on September 2, 2026.
website_content.markdown_content:
## Overview
The **Karnataka Examinations Authority (KEA)** is conducting the Round 2 Option Entry for the **Diploma Common Entrance Test (DCET) 2026**. This is a critical step for diploma holders seeking lateral entry admission into the second year (third semester) of B.E./B.Tech engineering degrees and first-year Architecture courses across Karnataka.

## Key Details
* **Purpose:** Lateral Entry Admission
* **Target Audience:** Diploma holders who did not receive an allotment in Round 1 or those wishing to revise their preferences.
* **Option Entry Start Date:** 2nd September 2026

## Important Dates
* **Round 1 Web Option Entry:** August 17, 2026
* **Round 1 Mock/Provisional Allotment:** August 6, 2026
* **Round 2 Option Entry Window:** Started 2nd September 2026

## Step-by-Step Option Entry Process
1. **Visit Official Portals:** Access the KEA official websites.
2. **Login:** Use your DCET 2026 CET number and password.
3. **Course Selection:** Select your preferred courses from the available list.
4. **College Selection:** Choose colleges offering those courses.
5. **Prioritize:** Arrange college-course combinations in order of preference (1, 2, 3...).
6. **Lock & Submit:** Review your choices carefully, submit, and lock them before the deadline.
7. **Documentation:** Download a printout of the submitted form for your records.

## Critical Instructions
* **Official Links Only:** Use only the authorized KEA portals to avoid fraud.
* **Comprehensive List:** Enter as many realistic choices as possible, as options cannot be added after the window closes.
* **Proof of Submission:** Always keep a screenshot or printout of your locked choices.

website_content.markdown_content:
## Overview
The **Chhattisgarh Public Service Commission (CGPSC)** has officially released the Interview Call Letters for the **State Service Examination 2025 (eService)**. Candidates who have successfully cleared the Mains stage are now eligible to download their call letters and essential proformas.

## Important Dates
* **Prelims Examination:** 22nd February 2026
* **Mains Examination:** 6th to 9th June 2026
* **Interview Call Letter Release:** 2nd September 2026

## Key Details
* **Total Vacancies:** 239
* **Current Stage:** Interview Phase
* **Download Mode:** Online via registered login credentials

## How to Download Interview Call Letter
1. Visit the official candidate login portal: `online.ecgpsconline.in`.
2. Log in using your registered **Email ID and Password**.
3. Navigate to the link for **"State Service Examination 2025 (eService) Interview Call Letter and Required Proformas."**
4. Download the call letter and the specified proformas in PDF format.
5. Ensure you take at least **two printouts** (one for the interview and one backup).

## Required Documents for Interview
Candidates must carry the following documents to the venue:
* Printed Interview Call Letter
* Duly filled proformas (available on the portal)
* Valid Photo ID Proof
* Original and photocopies of Educational Certificates
* Caste/Category Certificate (if applicable)
* Domicile Certificate
* Recent passport-size photographs

## Important Instructions
* Call letters are **not sent by post**; they must be downloaded online.
* Report to the venue strictly at the time mentioned on your individual call letter.
* Any errors in personal details should be reported to CGPSC immediately.

website_content.title: SSC Junior Engineer (JE) Recruitment 2026 - Notification, Syllabus & Exam Pattern
website_content.summary: The Staff Selection Commission (SSC) has invited applications for Junior Engineer (Civil, Electrical, Mechanical, Telecom) and Scientific Assistant (IMD) posts. A total of 1,748 tentative vacancies are available for the 2026 session.
website_content.markdown_content:
## SSC JE 2026 Recruitment Overview
Staff Selection Commission (SSC) is conducting the Junior Engineer Examination 2026 to fill positions across various engineering disciplines and scientific roles.

**Key Details:**
* **Total Vacancies:** 1,748 (Tentative)
* **Posts:** JE (Civil), JE (Electrical & Mechanical), JE (Telecom), and Scientific Assistant (IMD)
* **Exam Mode:** Computer Based Examination (CBE) - Objective MCQ
* **Language:** Hindi & English

## Selection Process
The selection is conducted in four primary stages:
1. **Paper-I (CBE):** Qualifying shortlisting stage.
2. **Paper-II (CBE):** Final merit-deciding stage.
3. **Document Verification (DV)**
4. **Medical Examination**

## Exam Pattern
### Paper-I (Qualifying)
* **General Intelligence & Reasoning:** 50 Questions | 50 Marks
* **General Awareness:** 50 Questions | 50 Marks
* **General Engineering (Stream Specific):** 100 Questions | 100 Marks
* **Total:** 200 Marks | **Duration:** 2 Hours
* **Negative Marking:** 0.25 per wrong answer

### Paper-II (Merit Stage)
* **General Engineering (Opted Stream):** 100 Questions | 300 Marks
* **Duration:** 2 Hours
* **Negative Marking:** 1.00 per wrong answer

## Stream-wise Syllabus
* **Civil & Structural:** Mechanics, Structural Analysis, Concrete/Steel Structures, Surveying, Soil Mechanics, Fluid Mechanics, Irrigation, and Transportation.
* **Electrical:** Network Theorems, Electrical Machines, Generation/Transmission, Power Electronics, and Measurement.
* **Mechanical:** Strength of Materials, Theory of Machines, Thermal Engineering, Fluid Mechanics, and Manufacturing Processes.
* **CS & IT:** Discrete Math, Data Structures, Algorithms, OS, Databases, and Computer Networks.
* **Electronics & Telecom:** Diodes, Transistors, Digital Electronics, Antennas, and Wireless Communication.
* **Physics:** Mechanics, Optics, Thermodynamics, Modern Physics, and Semiconductor Devices.
* **Telecommunication:** Signals & Systems, Analog/Digital Communication, and Electromagnetics.

## Important Notes for Candidates
* **On-Screen Tools:** A scientific calculator, IS 456:2000 Code, and Steam Tables will be provided on-screen. Physical copies are prohibited.
* **Difficulty Level:** Civil, Mechanical, and Electrical papers are set at the **Diploma level**, while CS/IT, Electronics, Physics, and Telecom are set at the **Graduation level**.
* **Minimum Qualifying Marks:** UR: 30% | OBC/EWS: 25% | Others: 20%.

website_content.title: UPSC CMS Result 2026 Out: Combined Medical Services Examination Written Result Declared
website_content.summary: The Union Public Service Commission (UPSC) has released the written examination results for the Combined Medical Services Examination (CMSE) 2026. Shortlisted candidates are now eligible for the Interview/Personality Test stage.
website_content.markdown_content:
## UPSC CMS Result 2026 Overview
The **Union Public Service Commission (UPSC)** has officially declared the results for the Combined Medical Services Examination (CMSE) 2026. This result is based on the written examination conducted on **August 2, 2026**.

## Key Examination Dates
* **Written Exam Date:** August 2, 2026
* **Result Declaration Date:** September 1, 2026
* **Application Window:** March 11, 2026, to March 31, 2026

## Vacancy Details
A total of **1,358 vacancies** were notified for the roles of **Medical Officer** and **Assistant Medical Officer**. These positions are distributed across various prestigious government bodies, including:
* Indian Railways
* Municipal Corporation of Delhi (MCD)
* New Delhi Municipal Council (NDMC)

## Next Steps for Qualified Candidates
Candidates whose roll numbers appear in the result PDF must complete the following actions **within 15 days** of the result declaration:
1. **Portal Login:** Access the UPSC online portal.
2. **Update Details:** Refresh your educational qualification details.
3. **Document Upload:** Upload all necessary proof of eligibility.

## Required Documents for Interview/Verification
While the official call letter will provide the final checklist, candidates should prepare:
* **MBBS Degree** certificate and mark sheets
* **Medical Registration** (Permanent or Provisional)
* **Date of Birth Proof** (10th Certificate)
* **Category Certificates** (SC/ST/OBC/EWS/PwBD), if applicable
* **Photo ID** and recent passport-size photographs

website_content.title: GATE 2027 Registration Open - Apply via GOAPS Portal
website_content.summary: IIT Madras has opened the application window for the Graduate Aptitude Test in Engineering (GATE) 2027. Eligible candidates can apply online through the GOAPS portal until September 27, 2026.
website_content.markdown_content:
## GATE 2027 Overview
The **Graduate Aptitude Test in Engineering (GATE) 2027** is being conducted by **IIT Madras** on behalf of the National Coordination Board-GATE, Ministry of Education. This exam is the gateway for M.Tech/Ph.D. admissions and recruitment in various Public Sector Undertakings (PSUs).

## 📅 Important Dates
* **Registration Start Date:** August 27, 2026
* **Regular Registration Deadline:** September 27, 2026
* **Extended Registration (with Late Fee):** October 5, 2026
* **Application Correction Window:** October 14 to October 21, 2026
* **Exam City Allotment:** January 4, 2027
* **Exam Dates:** February 6, 7, 13, 14, 20, and 21, 2027

## 💰 Application Fee
| Category | Regular Fee | Extended Fee |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Female / SC / ST / PwD | ₹1,000 per paper | ₹1,500 per paper |
| General / OBC-NCL / EWS | ₹2,000 per paper | ₹2,500 per paper |

## 🛠️ Key Requirements & Instructions
* **DigiLocker Mandatory:** A verified DigiLocker account is compulsory for all Indian national applicants.
* **Exam Mode:** Computer-Based Test (CBT) with a duration of 3 hours.
* **Facial Recognition:** New facial recognition systems are expected for registration and verification.
* **Paper Selection:** Candidates can opt for one or two approved test paper combinations.

## 📝 How to Apply
1. Visit the official GOAPS portal.
2. Ensure your **DigiLocker account** is linked and verified.
3. Register to generate an Enrolment ID and Password.
4. Fill in academic and personal details.
5. Select the test paper and preferred exam cities.
6. Upload required documents (Photo/Signature).
7. Pay the fee and submit the application.

website_content.title: MDU Rohtak Mercy Chance / Special Chance Admit Card 2026
website_content.summary: Maharshi Dayanand University (MDU), Rohtak has released the admit cards for the Mercy Chance/Special Chance 2026 scheme. Eligible students seeking to clear pending examinations can now download their hall tickets for the September 2026 exams.
website_content.markdown_content:
## Overview
Maharshi Dayanand University (MDU), Rohtak provides the **Mercy Chance/Special Chance** scheme to allow eligible students an additional opportunity to clear their pending examinations and complete their degrees.

## Important Dates
* **Application Start Date:** 15 May 2026
* **Application Deadline:** 30 July 2026 (Extended)
* **Admit Card Release Date:** 1 September 2026
* **Examination Date:** September 2026 (Exact dates to be confirmed)

## Fee Structure (Course-Wise)
Fees vary based on the chance number (1st, 2nd, or 3rd):

* **General Courses (BA, BSc, BCom, MA, MSc, Diploma):** ₹15,000 to ₹21,000
* **Professional Courses (MBA, LLB, MCA, B.Tech, B.Pharm, B.Ed):** ₹20,000 to ₹27,000
* **Integrated Courses (5/6 Year):** ₹15,000 to ₹27,000

## How to Download Admit Card
1. Visit the official admit card portal.
2. Enter your **Student ID/No** or **Registration Number**.
3. Submit the details to view your Reappear Admit Card.
4. Verify all details (Name, Roll No, Center) and print the document.

## Crucial Instructions for Candidates
* **Identity Proof:** Candidates must carry a valid **original photo ID** to the exam center.
* **Practical Exams:** Report to the **practical exam center**, not the theory center mentioned by default on the admit card.
* **Payment Issues:** If the fee status shows "Un-Paid" despite payment, email `[email protected]` with payment details.
* **Eligibility Issues:** If status shows "Not Eligible (NE)", visit the Result Branch at Pariksha Sadan, MDU Rohtak, at least 3 days before the exam.

website_content.markdown_content:
## TG TET In-Service Teachers 2026 Overview
The **Telangana Teacher Eligibility Test (TG TET)** for In-Service Teachers is now open for hall ticket downloads. This examination is mandatory for teachers currently working in Government, Local Body, and other specified institutions in Telangana.

## Key Exam Information
* **Exam Mode:** Computer-Based Test (CBT)
* **Papers:** 
    * **Paper I:** For Classes I–V
    * **Paper II:** For Classes VI–VIII
* **Purpose:** This qualification is valid **only for continuation in service or promotion**. It cannot be used for direct recruitment.

## Important Dates
* **Hall Ticket Release:** September 2, 2026
* **Examination Window:** September 7, 2026, to September 11, 2026
* **Result Declaration:** Between September 28 and September 30, 2026

## Download Requirements
To access the hall ticket, candidates must provide the following details:
* 12-digit **Aadhaar Number**
* **Journal Number** (from application/fee payment)
* Registered **Mobile Number**
* **Date of Birth** (DD/MM/YYYY)

## Mandatory Documents for Exam Centre
* Printed copy of the **TG TET Hall Ticket 2026**
* Original valid **Photo ID Proof**
* Any other documents mentioned in the official Information Bulletin

website_content.title: SSC JE Recruitment 2026 - Junior Engineer & Scientific Assistant
website_content.summary: Staff Selection Commission (SSC) invites online applications for 1748 tentative vacancies for Junior Engineer and Scientific Assistant posts. The deadline to apply is September 22, 2026.
website_content.markdown_content:
## SSC JE Recruitment 2026 Overview

The Staff Selection Commission (SSC) has announced the Junior Engineer (JE) Examination 2026. This recruitment covers multiple technical roles across various Central Government organizations, including the India Meteorological Department (IMD).

**Key Highlights:**
* **Total Vacancies:** 1748 (Tentative)
* **Post Category:** Group 'B', Level-6
* **Application Mode:** Online only

## Posts Offered
* **Junior Engineer (Civil)**
* **Junior Engineer (Electrical)**
* **Junior Engineer (Mechanical)**
* **Junior Engineer (Electrical & Mechanical)**
* **Junior Engineer (Telecom)**
* **Scientific Assistant (IMD)**

## Important Dates
* **Application Start Date:** 02.09.2026
* **Application Deadline:** 22.09.2026 (23:00 hrs)
* **Fee Payment Deadline:** 23.09.2026
* **Correction Window:** 28.09.2026 to 30.09.2026
* **Paper-I Exam (Tentative):** October/November 2026
* **Paper-II Exam (Tentative):** December 2026

## Eligibility Criteria

### Educational Qualification
* **JE (Civil/Electrical/Mechanical):** Degree or Diploma in the respective engineering discipline from a recognized institute.
* **JE (Telecom):** Bachelor's degree in Engineering/Technology (Electrical, Electronics, CS, IT, etc.).
* **Scientific Assistant (IMD):** Bachelor's degree in Science with Physics or relevant Engineering degree.

### Age Limit (as of 01.08.2026)
* **General:** Up to 30 or 32 years (depending on the organization).
* **Relaxation:** SC/ST (5 years), OBC (3 years), PwBD (10-15 years).

## Selection Process
1. **Paper-I (CBE):** Qualifying exam covering Reasoning, General Awareness, and Technical subjects.
2. **Paper-II (CBE):** In-depth technical subject examination.
3. **Document Verification:** Verification of original certificates.
4. **Medical/Physical Standards:** Applicable for specific posts (e.g., BRO/GREF).

## Application Fee
* **General/OBC/EWS (Male):** ₹100
* **Women/SC/ST/PwBD/Ex-SM:** Exempted

website_content.title: NEET UG 2026 Round 2 Counselling Registration 2026
website_content.summary: MCC has opened Round 2 counselling for MBBS, BDS, and other UG medical courses. Registration and choice filling began on September 3, 2026.
website_content.markdown_content:
## Overview
The Medical Counselling Committee (MCC) has officially opened the **NEET UG 2026 Round 2 counselling** registration. This round is critical for candidates who did not secure a seat in Round 1 or those seeking to upgrade their currently allotted seat.

## Courses and Institutions
Admission is available for **MBBS, BDS**, and other participating undergraduate medical courses across:
* 15% All India Quota (AIQ)
* Central Universities
* AIIMS & JIPMER
* ESIC institutes
* Deemed Universities

## Important Dates
| Event | Date |
| :--- | :--- |
| **Registration Starts** | September 3, 2026 |
| **Registration & Fee Payment Closes** | September 8, 2026 |
| **Choice Filling Window** | September 3 to September 9, 2026 |
| **Choice Locking Window** | September 8 to September 9, 2026 |
| **Seat Allotment Result** | September 11, 2026 |

## Step-by-Step Application Process
1. **Portal Access:** Visit the official MCC website.
2. **Registration:** Use 'New Registration' for first-timers or log in with existing Round 1 credentials.
3. **Details:** Enter personal, educational, and category information.
4. **Payment:** Complete the online registration fee payment.
5. **Choice Filling:** Select preferred colleges and courses in order of priority.
6. **Locking:** Review and lock your choices before the deadline to ensure they are considered.

## Key Candidate Instructions
* **Strict Deadlines:** MCC generally does not extend registration or choice-locking windows.
* **Verification:** Double-check college names, fee structures, and bond obligations before locking.
* **Security:** Never share your login credentials with third-party agents.

website_content.title: MPESB Subedar & Sub Inspector Recruitment 2026
website_content.summary: MPESB invites online applications for 507 posts of Subedar and Sub Inspector across non-technical and technical cadres. The application window closes on September 23, 2026.
website_content.markdown_content:
## Recruitment Overview
The Madhya Pradesh Employees Selection Board (MPESB) is recruiting for **507 vacancies** in the Subedar and Sub Inspector cadres for the Home (Police) Department.

## Important Dates
* **Application Start Date:** 09.09.2026
* **Application Last Date:** 23.09.2026
* **Correction Window:** 09.09.2026 to 28.09.2026
* **Preliminary Exam Date:** 28.10.2026

## Vacancy Breakdown
* **Sub Inspector (District Police Force):** 312
* **Subedar:** 81
* **Sub Inspector (SAF):** 69
* **Sub Inspector (Technical - Arms/Photo/QD/Finger Print):** 45

## Eligibility Criteria
### Educational Qualification
* **Subedar / SI (SAF/DEF):** Graduate degree from a recognized university.
* **SI (Arms):** 3-year Diploma in Mechanical Engineering.
* **SI (Photo/QD/Finger Print):** Bachelor's degree in Mathematics, Physics, and Chemistry.

### Age Limit (as of 23.09.2026)
* **Male (UR):** 33 Years
* **Male/Female (Reserved/MP Domicile):** 38 Years
* **Female (MP Domicile):** 38 Years
* **Special Relaxations:** Up to 43 years for specific categories (inter-caste marriage/Vikram Award winners).

## Selection Process
1. **Preliminary Written Exam:** Objective type (100 Marks).
2. **Main Written Exam:** Two to three compulsory papers (600-900 Marks).
3. **Physical Efficiency Test (PET):** 800m race, Long Jump, and Shot Put.
4. **Interview:** Final stage (50 Marks).

## Salary & Benefits
**Pay Level 9:** ₹36,200 – ₹1,14,800. Candidates undergo a 3-year probation with a graded stipend (70%, 80%, and 90% of minimum pay).

website_content.title: ICAI CA Foundation September 2026 Exam Date & Schedule
website_content.summary: The Institute of Chartered Accountants of India (ICAI) has announced the examination dates for the CA Foundation September 2026 session. The exams are scheduled to take place on September 2, 5, 7, and 9, 2026.
website_content.markdown_content:
## CA Foundation September 2026 Exam Overview
The **Institute of Chartered Accountants of India (ICAI)** has released the official schedule for the CA Foundation September 2026 session. Candidates must ensure they have completed their registration within the stipulated deadlines to be eligible for the admit card.

## 📅 Key Exam Dates
* **Paper 1: Principles and Practice of Accounting** - September 2, 2026
* **Paper 2: Business Laws and BCR** - September 5, 2026
* **Paper 3: Business Mathematics, LR & Statistics** - September 7, 2026
* **Paper 4: Business Economics and BCK** - September 9, 2026

## ⏰ Exam Timings
* **Reporting Time:** 1:30 PM
* **Exam Start Time:** 2:00 PM
* **Duration:** 
    * Papers 1 & 2: 3 Hours (Ends at 5:00 PM)
    * Papers 3 & 4: 2 Hours (Ends at 4:00 PM)

## 🗓️ Important Application Timeline
* **Online Application Start:** July 6, 2026
* **Deadline (Without Late Fee):** July 19, 2026
* **Deadline (With Late Fee of ₹600):** July 22, 2026
* **Correction Window:** July 23 to July 25, 2026
* **Admit Card Release:** Expected last week of August 2026

## 📝 How to Apply
1. Visit the official ICAI exam portal.
2. Log in via the **Self Service Portal (SSP)** credentials.
3. Select the relevant CA Foundation exam form.
4. Enter required details and pay the applicable fee.
5. Submit the form and download the confirmation page.

## ⚠️ Important Instructions
* The **correction window** is available only once; verify all details carefully.
* A **valid admit card** is mandatory for entry into the exam center.
* Only candidates who successfully submit the exam form will receive admit cards.

website_content.title: MAH B.Pharma/ Pharm.D Final Merit List 2026
website_content.summary: The State CET Cell, Maharashtra will release the final merit list for B.Pharmacy and Pharm.D courses on September 3, 2026. This list will be the basis for seat allotment in CAP Round 1.
website_content.markdown_content:
## Overview
The **State CET Cell, Maharashtra** is set to publish the final merit list for candidates seeking admission into the four-year **B.Pharmacy** and six-year **Pharm.D** courses. This list is the definitive ranking used for the CAP Round 1 seat allotment process.

## Important Dates
* **Final Merit List Release:** September 3, 2026 (Expected)
* **Category-wise Seat Matrix:** September 4, 2026
* **CAP Round 1 Web Option Form Filling:** September 5 to 7, 2026

## How to Check Your Final Merit Status
1. Visit the official CAP portal.
2. Locate and click the **Final Merit List** link in the notifications section.
3. Enter your **Application ID** (e.g., PH26100xxx) and **Date of Birth**.
4. Verify your State Merit Number, Category, and Candidate Type (MS/AI).
5. Download and print the final merit status slip for admission purposes.

## Critical Instructions for Candidates
* **Validity:** Provisional merit numbers are no longer valid; only the final merit list will be used for allotment.
* **Verification:** Carefully cross-check your **Category** and **Candidate Type** before filling the option form.
* **Preparation:** Review the seat matrix released on September 4 before starting the web option filling process on September 5.

AP EdCET counselling is conducted for candidates seeking admission into **B.Ed courses** across Andhra Pradesh. The process is entirely online, encompassing registration, verification, and seat allocation.

## Eligibility Criteria
* Candidates must have qualified for the AP EdCET exam.
* A **minimum score of 40 marks** is required to be eligible for counselling.

## Counselling Process Stages
1. **Online Registration:** Initial sign-up and fee payment.
2. **Document Verification:** Uploading and verifying scanned certificates.
3. **Web Options Entry:** Choosing preferred colleges and courses.
4. **Seat Allotment:** Allocation of seats based on rank and preference.
5. **Self-Reporting:** Confirming admission at the allotted college.

## Important Dates (Expected)
* **Phase 1 Registration:** September 2026
* **Phase 2 Registration:** September 2026
* **Spot Admission Process:** October 2026
* **Closing of Portal:** October 2026

## Required Documents for Upload
* AP EdCET Rank Card & Allotment Letter
* Class 10th and 12th (10+2) Mark Sheets
* Income Certificate & Caste Certificate
* Migration Certificate & Transfer Certificate
* Aadhaar Card

## How to Apply
* Visit the official portal and click on **'Candidate Registration'**.
* Log in using your **Date of Birth** and **Hall Ticket Number**.
* Fill in academic details and upload scanned documents.
* Pay the processing fee online to finalize the application.

website_content.summary: The Indira Gandhi National Open University (IGNOU) has officially released the Term-End Examination (TEE) results for the June 2026 session. Students who appeared for exams between June and July 2026 can now access their scorecards online.
website_content.markdown_content:
## IGNOU June 2026 TEE Result Overview

Indira Gandhi National Open University (IGNOU) has announced the results for the **June 2026 Term-End Examination (TEE)**. This notification applies to all students who appeared in the examination cycle held from **1st June to 21st July 2026**.

### Key Highlights
* **Result Date:** 2nd September 2026
* **Exam Cycle:** June 2026 Session
* **Status:** Final Regular Results / Early Declaration

### How to Check Your Result
1. Visit the official result portal.
2. Select the **"Term End Exam (TEE)"** option.
3. Choose the **June 2026 Exam Result** type.
4. Enter your **9 or 10-digit enrollment number**.
5. Click **Search** to view and download your subject-wise marks.

### Details Available on Scorecard
* Enrollment Number & Programme Code
* Course-wise marks obtained
* Maximum marks & Grade
* Pass/Fail status and Examination center details

### Revaluation Process
Students dissatisfied with their scores can apply for revaluation:
* **Application Window:** Typically opens within 30 days of the final result.
* **Fee:** ₹750 per course.
* **Method:** Apply online via the IGNOU online services or Samarth portal.

website_content.markdown_content:
## Uttarakhand NEET UG Counselling 2026 Overview
The Uttarakhand State Centralised Counselling Board, operating through Hemwati Nandan Bahuguna Uttarakhand Medical Education University (HNBUMU), has issued a revised schedule for Round 1 college reporting for **MBBS and BDS** courses.

## Revised Important Dates
* **Round 1 Registration & Choice Filling:** August 13 to 24, 2026
* **Data Processing:** August 25 and 26, 2026
* **Seat Allotment Result:** August 27, 2026
* **Revised Reporting Deadline:** **September 5, 2026**

## How to Check Round 1 Result
1. Visit the official portal at **hnbumu.ac.in**.
2. Log in using your registration number and password.
3. Click on the **Round 1 seat allotment result** link.
4. Download and print your allotment letter for reporting.

## Key Instructions for Candidates
* **Mandatory Reporting:** Candidates must report to the allotted college by the deadline to secure their seat.
* **Documents Required:** Keep original and photocopies of NEET UG 2026 admit card, scorecard, and all academic certificates ready.
* **Updates:** No individual communication will be sent; candidates must monitor the official website regularly.
* **Free Exit:** Candidates wishing to use the free exit facility must follow the official bulletin guidelines.

## UPPSC LT Grade Assistant Teacher Mains Result 2026

The **Uttar Pradesh Public Service Commission (UPPSC)** has officially released the Mains examination results for the post of **Assistant Teacher (LT Grade/Trained Graduate)** for specific subjects.

* **Subjects Declared:** Commerce, Agriculture, and Horticulture.

* **Selection Process:** Preliminary Exam $\rightarrow$ Mains (Written) Exam $\rightarrow$ Document Verification

### 🛠️ Documents Required for Verification
Candidates appearing in the selection list must prepare the following documents:
* **Examination Proof:** Mains Admit Card and Preliminary qualifying proof.
* **Educational Credentials:** High School, Intermediate, and Graduation degree certificates.
* **Professional Qualification:** B.Ed. or NCTE-recognized teacher-training certificate.
* **Identity & Category:** Valid Photo ID (Aadhaar), Category Certificate (SC/ST/OBC/EWS), and recent passport-size photographs.

website_content.title: EdCIL KVS PMU Technical Manpower Recruitment 2026
website_content.summary: EdCIL (India) Limited is inviting online applications for 13 contractual technical positions for the KVS Project Monitoring Unit in New Delhi. The application window is open from September 2 to September 15, 2026.
website_content.markdown_content:
## Overview
EdCIL (India) Limited, a Mini Ratna Category-I CPSE, is recruiting technical manpower on a contractual basis for the newly established **Project Monitoring Unit (PMU)** at the Kendriya Vidyalaya Sangathan (KVS) Headquarters, New Delhi. This unit will oversee the execution of infrastructure and construction projects nationwide.

## Vacancy Details
Total Positions: **13 (Contractual)**

| Post Name | Vacancies |
| :--- | :--- |
| Architect | 1 |
| Senior Engineer (Civil) | 1 |
| Engineer (Civil) | 2 |
| Junior Engineer (Civil) | 6 |
| AutoCAD/Revit Operator | 1 |
| Young Professional (Data Mgmt) | 2 |

## Eligibility Criteria
* **Nationality:** Indian Nationals only.
* **Cut-off Date:** Qualifications and experience must be acquired by **31.07.2026**.

### Post-wise Requirements:
* **Architect:** B.Arch + 10 years experience in institutional building design.
* **Sr. Engineer (Civil):** B.Tech/B.E Civil + 10 years experience in construction supervision.
* **Engineer (Civil):** B.Tech/B.E Civil + 7 years experience in building construction.
* **Junior Engineer (Civil):** Diploma/B.Tech Civil + 1-3 years experience.
* **AutoCAD/Revit Operator:** Diploma Civil/ITI Drafting + 2 years BIM/3D experience.
* **Young Professional:** B.Tech (CS/IT)/BCA/B.Sc (IT) + 2 years MIS/Data Analytics experience.

## Remuneration (Consolidated Monthly)
* **Architect / Sr. Engineer:** ₹80,000 – ₹1,00,000
* **Engineer (Civil):** ₹60,000 – ₹80,000
* **JE / AutoCAD Op / Young Professional:** ₹35,000 – ₹40,000

## Important Dates
* **Notification Date:** 02-09-2026
* **Application Start Date:** 02-09-2026
* **Application Last Date:** 15-09-2026
* **Application Fee:** Nil

## Selection Process
Selection is based on professional qualifications and experience. Shortlisted candidates may be called for an **Interview** via email.

website_content.title: South Eastern Railway (SER) Scouts & Guides Quota Recruitment 2026-27
website_content.summary: RRC South Eastern Railway invites applications for 10 vacancies in Level-1 and Level-2 categories under the Scouts & Guides Quota. Applications are open from September 7 to October 6, 2026.
website_content.markdown_content:
## Recruitment Overview
South Eastern Railway (SER) has released the official notification for recruitment under the **Scouts & Guides Quota for 2026-27**. This is a specialized recruitment for candidates who possess both the required educational qualifications and mandatory Scouts & Guides certifications.

## Vacancy Details
* **Level-2 (Group C):** 02 Posts
* **Level-1 (Erstwhile Group D):** 08 Posts
* **Total Vacancies:** 10

## Eligibility Criteria
### Educational Qualification
* **For Level-2:** 12th (+2 stage) with minimum 50% marks OR 10th Pass with NAC/ITI approved by NCVT.
* **For Level-1:** 10th Pass or ITI or equivalent qualification (NAC granted by NCVT).

### Mandatory Scouts & Guides Qualification
Candidates **must** fulfill the following to be eligible:
* Must be a **President Scout/Guide/Rover/Ranger** OR a **Himalayan Wood Badge (HWB)** holder.
* Minimum **5 years** of active membership in the Scouts Organization.
* Participation in at least **two National Level/All India Railway events** and **two State Level events**.

## Age Limit (As of 01-01-2027)
* **Level-2 (Group C):** 18 to 30 Years
* **Level-1 (Group D):** 18 to 33 Years
*(Age relaxation applies as per government norms)*

## Application Fee
* **General/OBC:** ₹500 (Refundable ₹400 after written test)
* **SC/ST/ESM/PwBD/Women/Minority/EBC:** ₹250 (Refundable ₹250 after written test)

## Selection Process
1. **Written Test:** 60 Marks (40 Objective + 20 Essay) focusing on Scouts & Guides and GK.
2. **Certificate Evaluation:** 40 Marks based on achievements.
3. **Document Verification**
4. **Medical Examination**

## Important Dates
* **Notification Release:** 01 September 2026
* **Application Start Date:** 07 September 2026
* **Application Deadline:** 06 October 2026

website_content.summary: Northern Coalfields Limited (NCL) invites online applications for 73 Intern positions under Round 3 of the Prime Minister Internship Scheme (PMIS) for FY 2026-27.
website_content.markdown_content:
## Overview
Northern Coalfields Limited (NCL), a Miniratna PSU and subsidiary of Coal India Limited, is offering **73 internship vacancies** across various disciplines under the Prime Minister Internship Scheme (PMIS) for the financial year 2026-27.

## Vacancy Details
The vacancies are distributed across the following trade/discipline combinations:

* **Foreman (Electrical):** 17 Posts (Diploma in Electrical)
* **Foreman (Mechanical):** 16 Posts (Diploma in Mechanical)
* **Lab Technician:** 13 Posts (B.Sc in Chemistry)
* **Clerk:** 9 Posts (Bachelor of Commerce)
* **Pharmacist:** 9 Posts (Diploma in Pharmacy)
* **Overseer:** 9 Posts (Diploma in Civil)

## Eligibility Criteria
* **Age Limit:** 18 to 25 years (as of 01-04-2026).
* **Education:** Candidates must hold the relevant diploma or degree from a recognized institute/university as specified in the trade list.

## Internship Benefits & Terms
* **Stipend:** ₹9,000 per month (credited to Aadhaar-linked bank account).
* **Duration:** 9 months from the date of engagement.
* **Selection Process:** Based on the merit list (aggregate percentage scores of the qualifying examination in descending order).
* **Nature of Engagement:** This is a training internship and does **not** lead to regular employment with NCL or Coal India Limited.

## Important Dates
* **Notification Date:** 01-09-2026
* **Crucial Date for Eligibility:** 01-04-2026
* **Application Deadline:** 06-09-2026

1. **Login:** Access the portal using your JELET 2026 application/roll number and password.
2. **Registration:** Complete the registration form and pay the required fee online.

4. **Locking:** Carefully review and lock your choices before the deadline to avoid rejection.

* **Documentation:** Keep your rank card and login credentials ready.

website_content.markdown_content:
## CVRDE DRDO ITI Apprentice Recruitment 2026

The Combat Vehicles Research & Development Establishment (CVRDE), a premier laboratory of the **Defence Research and Development Organisation (DRDO)**, is recruiting ITI Apprentice Trainees for its Avadi, Chennai campus.

### 📌 Vacancy Details
Total indicative vacancies: **93 posts** across 18 trades, including:
* **COPA:** 13 posts
* **Electrician:** 12 posts
* **Draughtsman (Mechanical):** 10 posts
* **Fitter:** 10 posts
* **Electronics Mechanic:** 6 posts
* **Turner/Machinist/Welder:** Multiple posts
* **Other trades:** Plumber, Painter, Photographer, Book Binder, and more.

### 🎓 Eligibility Criteria
* **Educational Qualification:** Must have passed ITI from a recognized NCVT/SCVT institution (minimum 2-year duration, except for specific trades like COPA, Painter, Plumber, Welder, and Food Production).
* **Candidate Type:** Only **Regular candidates** are eligible; private candidates are not allowed.
* **Passing Year:** Must have passed the qualifying exam in **2023, 2024, 2025, or 2026**.

### ⏳ Age Limit (as on 01-09-2026)
* **UR:** 18 - 27 Years
* **OBC:** 18 - 30 Years
* **SC/ST:** 18 - 32 Years
* **PWD:** 18 - 37 Years

### 🗓️ Walk-In Interview Schedule
* **Dates:** 08-09-2026 and 09-09-2026
* **Time:** 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM
* **Venue:** CVRDE, Avadi, Chennai-600054, Tamil Nadu

### 🛠️ Selection Process
1. **Shortlisting:** Based on marks obtained in the qualifying ITI examination.
2. **Interview:** Walk-in interview on the specified dates.
3. **Joining:** Selected candidates will receive their **joining letter on the spot**.

### 📄 Required Documents
* 10th/12th Marksheet & Certificate
* ITI Marksheets & NCVT/SCVT Certificate
* Valid Caste Certificate (if applicable)
* Aadhaar Card
* **Mandatory NCVT/SCVT MIS Portal Registration Number**

website_content.markdown_content:
## 📌 Recruitment Overview
The Office of the Principal District and Sessions Judge, Uttara Kannada, Karwar has announced vacancies for subordinate court staff under Notification No. 1/2026. 

##  vacancies Distribution
* **Process Server:** 13 Posts
* **Peon:** 65 Posts
* **Total Vacancies:** 78

## 🎓 Eligibility Criteria
### Educational Qualification
* **Process Server:** Pass in SSLC or equivalent. **Preference:** Candidates with a Heavy/Light Motor Vehicle (HMV/LMV) driving licence.
* **Peon:** Pass in SSLC or equivalent. Must be proficient in reading and writing **Kannada**.

### Age Limit (as of 16-09-2026)
* **General Category:** Max 40 years
* **Category-IIA, IIB, IIIA, IIIB:** Max 43 years
* **SC/ST and Category-I:** Max 45 years
*(Note: An additional 5-year relaxation is applicable for this specific recruitment per Govt Order dated 29 Jan 2026).* 

## 💰 Salary & Pay Scale
* **Process Server:** Rs. 31,775 to Rs. 61,300
* **Peon:** Rs. 27,000 to Rs. 46,675
* All selected candidates will undergo a probation period of two years.

## ⚙️ Selection Process
1. **Shortlisting:** Candidates are shortlisted for interviews based on the percentage of marks in the qualifying SSLC examination.
   * Ratio for Process Server: 1:25
   * Ratio for Peon: 1:10
2. **Interview:** Final selection is based on the marks scored in the interview (10 marks).

## 📅 Important Dates
* **Application Start Date:** 17 August 2026
* **Application Last Date:** 16 September 2026 (11:59 PM)
* **Fee Payment Deadline:** 17 September 2026

## 💸 Application Fee
* **General Category:** Rs. 300 / Rs. 150
* **SC/ST/Cat-I/PwBD:** Exempted
* **Payment Mode:** Online via SBI Collect only.

website_content.markdown_content:
## Bombay High Court Peon Result 2026

The High Court of Bombay has officially announced the results for the **Peon/Hamal/Farash** recruitment for 2026. Candidates who appeared for the screening/written test on April 26, 2026, can now check their qualification status.

### 📊 Shortlist Summary
A total of 6,895 candidates have been shortlisted for the next stage (Physical Fitness and Special Skill Test):

* **Principal Seat (Bombay):** 5,517 Candidates
* **Nagpur Bench:** 1,378 Candidates

### 📉 Cut-Off Marks
Candidates must have scored equal to or above the following marks to qualify:

* **Principal Seat (Bombay):** 24 Marks
* **Nagpur Bench:** 25 Marks

### 🛠 Selection Process
The final selection consists of the following stages:
1. Written/Screening Test (Completed)
2. Skill/Typing Test
3. Interview
4. Physical Fitness Test

### 🔍 How to Check Your Result
1. Visit the official website **bombayhighcourt.nic.in**.
2. Navigate to the **'Recruitment'** tab.
3. Click on the **'Clerk & Bombay High Court Peon Result'** link.
4. Download the PDF and use **Ctrl+F** to search for your roll number or name.

### ⚠️ Important Instructions
* **Verify Details:** Cross-check your name, registration ID, and category on the PDF.
* **Next Stage:** The schedule for the Physical Fitness and Special Skill Test will be announced separately on the official portal.
* **Documents:** Keep your registration ID and application password ready for accessing your detailed scorecard.

website_content.title: Solapur DC Aaple Sarkar Seva Kendra Recruitment 2026
website_content.summary: The District Collector of Solapur is inviting applications for 592 Aaple Sarkar Seva Kendra locations. Eligible 12th pass local residents can apply offline by September 30, 2026.
website_content.markdown_content:
## Recruitment Overview
The Office of the District Collector and Chairman, District Setu Committee, Solapur has announced vacancies for **Aaple Sarkar Seva Kendra (Kendra Operators)** across various rural and urban locations in the Solapur district.

## Key Highlights
* **Total Vacant Locations:** 592
* **Application Mode:** Offline (Form downloaded online and submitted in person)
* **Selection Process:** Document Verification followed by an Interview (No written exam)

## Eligibility Criteria
* **Educational Qualification:** Must have passed the Higher Secondary School Certificate (**12th / H.S.C.**) examination.
* **Age Limit:** Minimum **18 years** as of the date of application.
* **Residency:** Must be a **local resident** of the specific area/village for which the application is being submitted.
* **Other Requirements:** 
    * No criminal background (financial fraud or cyber crime).
    * Must not be a current government/semi-government employee.
    * Must not have previously operated an Aaple Sarkar Seva Kendra.

## Important Dates
* **Application Start Date:** September 1, 2026
* **Application Last Date:** September 30, 2026 (Up to 5:00 PM)
* **Submission Window:** 11:00 AM to 5:00 PM (excluding govt holidays)

## How to Apply
1. Download the prescribed application form and the list of 592 vacant locations from the official website.
2. Complete the form clearly by hand (avoid overwriting).
3. Attach **Annexure-A** (Infrastructure report) and **Annexure-B** (Business plan).
4. Include self-attested copies of Aadhaar card, PAN card, Nationalized bank passbook, and two residential proofs.
5. **Submit in person** at: Setu Sankalan, Revenue Branch, 1st Floor, Collector Office, near Government Milk Dairy, Saat Rasta Parisar, Solapur – 413003.

website_content.title: UP NEET UG Counselling 2026 Admission Process
website_content.summary: DGME UP has reopened and extended registration for MBBS, BDS, and other medical courses for the 2026-27 session. The extended registration deadline is September 2, 2026.
website_content.markdown_content:
## Overview
The Directorate General of Medical Education and Training, Uttar Pradesh (DGME UP) is conducting counselling for admission to **MBBS, BDS, and other medical courses**. This process covers 85% of state quota seats in government colleges and 100% of seats in private and minority institutions.

## Important Dates
* **Extended Registration Deadline:** September 2, 2026
* **Choice Filling Window:** September 2 to September 5, 2026
* **Academic Session Starts:** September 8, 2026

## Fee Structure
* **Registration Fee:** Rs. 2,000 (Non-refundable)
* **Govt Seat Security Deposit:** Rs. 30,000 (Refundable)
* **Private Seat Security Deposit:** Up to Rs. 2,00,000 (Refundable)

## Required Documents
* NEET UG 2026 Admit Card & Scorecard
* Class 10th & 12th Marksheets and Certificates
* Category Certificate (SC/ST/OBC/EWS), if applicable
* Domicile/Residence Certificate
* Valid Photo ID Proof & Passport-size photographs
* Payment receipt of registration and security deposit

## Application Process
1. Visit the official portal and click on the registration link.
2. Fill in personal, academic, and contact details.
3. Select a nodal center for document verification.
4. Upload required documents and pay the registration fee.
5. Deposit the applicable security money.
6. Download the registration form and await the merit list for choice filling.

website_content.title: APPSC Group-A & Group-B Gazetted (Technical) Recruitment 2026
website_content.summary: APPSC is inviting online applications for 155 Gazetted Technical posts across Agriculture, Horticulture, Veterinary, and Sericulture departments. Eligible APST candidates can apply from September 10 to September 30, 2026.
website_content.markdown_content:
## Recruitment Overview
The Arunachal Pradesh Public Service Commission (APPSC) has announced vacancies for **Group-A and Group-B Gazetted (Technical) posts**. This is a prestigious opportunity for technical graduates who are permanent residents of Arunachal Pradesh.

## Vacancy Details
| Post Name | Total Posts | Grade & Pay Scale |
| :--- | :---: | :--- |
| Veterinary Officer | 66 | Group-A, Level 10 (₹56,100–₹1,77,500) |
| Horticulture Development Officer | 45 | Group-A, Level 10 (₹56,100–₹1,77,500) |
| Agriculture Development Officer | 42 | Group-A, Level 10 (₹56,100–₹1,77,500) |
| Assistant Director (Sericulture) | 1 | Group-A, Level 10 (₹56,100–₹1,77,500) |
| Dairy Development Officer | 1 | Group-B, Level 6 (₹35,400–₹1,12,400) |
**Total Vacancies: 155** (including 6 PwBD reserved posts).

## Mandatory Eligibility
To be eligible, candidates **must** satisfy the following:
* **Residence:** Citizen of India and Permanent Resident of Arunachal Pradesh (PRC holder).
* **Tribe Status:** Must hold a valid Arunachal Pradesh Scheduled Tribe (APST) Certificate.
* **Language:** Proficiency in an Indigenous Tribal Language of Arunachal Pradesh.

## Educational Qualification
* **Agriculture Development Officer:** B.Sc in Agriculture.
* **Horticulture Development Officer:** B.Sc in Horticulture.
* **Veterinary Officer:** B.V.Sc & Animal Husbandry + Registration with AP State Veterinary Council.
* **Assistant Director (Sericulture):** B.Sc + PG Diploma in Sericulture.
* **Dairy Development Officer:** B.Tech in Dairy Technology or equivalent (Food Tech/Bio-Tech).

## Important Dates
* **Notification Date:** 01.09.2026
* **Application Starts:** 10.09.2026 (5:00 PM)
* **Application Deadline:** 30.09.2026 (5:00 PM)

## Selection Process
1. **Screening Test:** (Objective type) only if applicants exceed the ratio.
2. **Written Examination (500 Marks):** 
    * General English & General Studies (150 Marks)
    * Subject Paper-I (150 Marks)
    * Subject Paper-II (150 Marks)
    * Viva-voce (50 Marks)

## Age Limit (as of 30.09.2026)
* **Minimum:** 21 Years
* **Maximum:** 35 Years
* **Relaxation:** +5 years for APST, +10 years for PwBD (+15 for APST-PwBD).

website_content.title: SBI PO Prelims Score Card 2026
website_content.summary: State Bank of India has released the Prelims Score Card for the Probationary Officer 2026 recruitment. Candidates can now verify their section-wise marks and qualifying status for the upcoming Mains Exam.
website_content.markdown_content:
## Overview
The **SBI PO Prelims Score Card 2026** has been officially released by the State Bank of India on **1st September 2026**. This scorecard provides a detailed breakdown of marks for candidates who appeared in the Preliminary Examination on 1st and 2nd August 2026.

## Key Recruitment Statistics
* **Post Name:** Probationary Officer (PO)
* **Total Vacancies:** 1,500
* **Total Candidates Appeared:** ~11 Lakh
* **Candidates Shortlisted for Mains:** 15,802

## Important Dates
* **Prelims Exam Date:** 1 & 2 August 2026
* **Prelims Result Date:** 28 August 2026
* **Score Card Release Date:** 1 September 2026
* **Mains Exam Date:** 12 September 2026

## How to Download the Score Card
1. Visit the official SBI website careers section.
2. Navigate to **Current Openings** and select the PO recruitment link (**CRPD/PO/2026-27/09**).
3. Click on the link for **SBI PO Prelims Score Card 2026**.
4. Log in using your **Registration Number/Roll Number** and **Password/Date of Birth**.
5. Enter the captcha and click **Submit** to view and download your mark sheet.

## Next Steps: SBI PO Mains Exam
Candidates who have qualified will appear for the Mains Exam on **12th September 2026**. The exam will consist of:
* **Objective Test:** Includes negative marking (0.25 per wrong answer).
* **Descriptive Paper:** Testing writing skills.
* **Focus Areas:** Reasoning, Data Analysis, English Language, and General/Banking Awareness.
