website_content.title: LBS Nursing & Allied Health Science Provisional Rank List 2026
website_content.summary: LBS Centre for Science and Technology has released the Provisional Rank List for B.Sc. Nursing and 18 Allied Health courses for the 2026-27 academic year. Candidates can now check their ranks to determine eligibility for the Centralized Allotment Process (CAP).
website_content.markdown_content:
## Overview
The **LBS Centre for Science and Technology (Government of Kerala)** has published the Provisional Rank List for admission to **B.Sc. Nursing and 18 Allied Health Science degree courses** for the academic year 2026-27.

## Key Highlights
* **Courses Covered:** B.Sc. Nursing, B.P.T., B.O.T., B.A.S.L.P., B.P.O., and 14 other professional degree courses.
* **Rank List Published:** 1 September 2026 at 5:00 PM.
* **Purpose:** This list is the basis for the **Centralized Allotment Process (CAP)** for government, government-aided, and self-financing colleges in Kerala.
* **Quota Categories:** State Merit, EWS, Ezhava, Muslim, OBH, LC/AI, OBC, Kudumbi, SC, ST, Dheevara, Viswakarma, and Kusavan.

## Eligibility Criteria
* **Age:** Minimum 17 years completed by 31 December 2026.
* **Academic Requirement:** Generally 50% in Physics, Chemistry, and Biology (45% for SEBC; Pass marks for SC/ST).
* **Nativity:** Indian citizens (Keralite/Non-Keralite classifications apply).

## Rank List Categories
* **Ranklist I:** B.Sc Nursing, PT, NT, CV, BC, MB
* **Ranklist II:** BASLP
* **Ranklist III:** BPO
* **Ranklist IV:** ML, EM, MR, RT, DT, RP, NM
* **Ranklist V:** B.Sc. Optometry
* **Ranklist VI:** B. AOTT
* **Ranklist VII:** BPT, BOT

## Important Dates
* **Notification Published:** 23-06-2026
* **Provisional Index Mark:** 21-08-2026
* **Provisional Rank List Published:** 01-09-2026

## Next Steps for Candidates
1. **Verify Rank:** Use the official portal to select the relevant Ranklist and Quota.
2. **Individual Details:** Log in using Application Number, Registration ID, and Password for detailed marks.
3. **Objections:** Submit complaints/objections through the portal within the specified window.
4. **Future Process:** Prepare for **Option Registration**, **Trial Allotment**, and the final **Centralized Allotment Process (CAP)**.

website_content.title: UP Police Home Guard PET/PST Admit Card 2026
website_content.summary: The UPPRPB has released the PET/PST Admit Cards for the Home Guard Enrollment-2025. Candidates who qualified the written exam can now download their hall tickets for tests scheduled between 8-16 September 2026.
website_content.markdown_content:
## UP Home Guard Recruitment 2026

The **Uttar Pradesh Police Recruitment and Promotion Board (UPPRPB)** has officially released the admit cards for the Physical Efficiency Test (PET) and Physical Standard Test (PST) for the Home Guard Enrollment-2025.

### 📌 Quick Highlights
* **Post Name:** UP Police Home Guard
* **Total Vacancies:** 41,424
* **Exam Venue:** Respective District Police Lines
* **Admit Card Status:** Released (1 September 2026)

### 🗓️ Important Dates
* **PET/PST Exam Dates:** 8 – 16 September 2026
* **Written Exam Result:** 28 June 2026
* **Online Application Period:** 18 Nov 2025 – 17 Dec 2025

### 📂 Documents Required for PET/PST
Candidates must carry the following to the venue:
* **Printed Admit Card:** A clear printout of the PET/PST or DV/PST hall ticket.
* **Educational Certificates:** Original certificates and one set of self-attested photocopies.
* **Identity Proof:** A valid government-issued photo ID proof.

### 🛠️ Steps to Download Admit Card
1. Visit the dedicated portal **hgupexam2025.com**.
2. Click on the **'UP Home Guard PET/PST Admit Card 2026'** login link.
3. Enter your **Enrollment Number, Registration Number, or Date of Birth**.
4. Enter the security captcha and click **Submit**.
5. Download the PDF and verify your reporting time and venue.

website_content.summary: KNRUHS has reopened online registration for MBBS and BDS Management Quota (Category B & C) admissions for the 2026-27 academic year. Eligible NEET UG 2026 qualified candidates can apply until September 4, 2026.
website_content.markdown_content:
## Overview
Kaloji Narayana Rao University of Health Sciences (KNRUHS), Warangal, has announced a reopened registration window for **MBBS and BDS admissions** under the Management Quota (Category B & Category C/NRI Quota) for the academic year 2026-27.

## Key Dates
* **Registration Start Date:** September 2, 2026 (6:00 AM)
* **Registration End Date:** September 4, 2026 (2:00 PM)

## Eligibility
* Candidates must be **NEET UG 2026 qualified**.

## Participating Institutions
* Private Un-aided Non-Minority and Minority Medical Colleges affiliated to KNRUHS.
* Neelima Institute of Medical Sciences (affiliated to Anurag University).
* Private Un-aided Dental Colleges affiliated to KNRUHS.
* Army College of Dental Sciences (Only for wards of Army personnel).

## Application Process
1. **Portal Registration:** Complete one-time mobile and email verification via OTP.
2. **Payment:** Pay the non-refundable registration and processing fee of **₹12,000**.
3. **Form Filling:** Use the registration number to log in and enter personal and academic details.
4. **Document Upload:** Upload scanned copies of all original certificates.
5. **Submission:** Submit and download the confirmation page.

## Important Instructions
* **Who should apply?** This window is exclusively for candidates who missed the original August 13–20 deadline. Those already registered do NOT need to apply again.
* **Quota Specific:** Registration for Management Quota is separate from the Competent Authority Quota.
* **Fee:** The ₹12,000 fee is non-refundable regardless of eligibility.

website_content.summary: KNRUHS is set to announce the Phase 1 seat allotment for TS NEET UG 2026 MBBS/BDS courses between September 2nd and 3rd. Candidates who completed their web options can now prepare for the allotment and admission process.
website_content.markdown_content:
## TS NEET UG 2026 Phase 1 Allotment Overview

The Kaloji Narayana Rao University of Health Sciences (KNRUHS) is processing candidate preferences for the **Competent Authority Quota (CQ) MBBS/BDS counselling**. The Phase 1 results are expected to be declared shortly.

## Key Dates
* **Final Merit List Published:** August 28, 2026
* **Web Options Window Closed:** September 1, 2026
* **Expected Seat Allotment Release:** September 2 - September 3, 2026

## Step-by-Step Admission Process
1. **Check Status:** Log in to the official portal using your TS NEET UG Registration Number and password.
2. **University Fee:** Pay **₹12,000 online** to generate the provisional allotment order.
3. **Download Order:** Print the official allotment letter and joining instructions.
4. **Physical Reporting:** Visit the allotted college with all original certificates within the specified schedule.
5. **Final Confirmation:** Complete document verification and pay the college tuition fee.

## Critical Instructions for Candidates
* **Mandatory Reporting:** Failure to pay the University Fee or report physically will result in **automatic cancellation** of admission and barring from subsequent rounds.
* **Upgradation (Phase 2):** To be eligible for Phase 2 upgrades, candidates **must** first accept and report to their Phase 1 allotment.
* **Service Bond:** Students admitted to Government Medical Colleges must submit a service bond on stamp paper for rural medical service.
* **Tie-Breaking Rule:** In case of identical scores, priority is given by: Biology marks $\rightarrow$ Chemistry marks $\rightarrow$ Fewer incorrect answers.

website_content.title: AP PGCET Counselling 2026 Registration
website_content.summary: Registration for AP PGCET 2026 postgraduate admissions begins on September 3. Qualified candidates must complete their registration by September 8 to secure seats in participating universities.
website_content.markdown_content:
## AP PGCET Counselling 2026 Overview

The Andhra Pradesh Post Graduate Common Entrance Test (AP PGCET) 2026 counselling process is now open for qualified candidates seeking admission into postgraduate programs across participating universities in Andhra Pradesh.

### 📅 Important Dates
* **Registration Start Date:** September 3, 2026
* **Registration Deadline:** September 8, 2026
* **Phase 1 Counselling:** September 2026
* **Phase 2 Counselling:** October 2026
* **M.P.Ed Counselling:** First week of September 2026

### 💳 Counselling Fees
* **OC / BC Category:** Rs. 700
* **SC / ST / PH Category:** Rs. 500

### ⚙️ Counselling Process (Rank-Wise)
1. **Registration:** Sign up on the official portal.
2. **Verification:** Submit required documents for verification.
3. **Web Options:** Select preferred courses and colleges in order of preference.
4. **Seat Allotment:** Seats are allocated based on rank and preference.
5. **Acceptance:** Use the **'Freeze'** option to secure the seat and pay the fee.
6. **Reporting:** Submit original documents at the allotted college.

### ⚠️ Critical Instructions
* **Lock Your Choices:** Ensure you lock your web options before the deadline to avoid automatic system locking.
* **Document Readiness:** Keep scanned copies of all eligibility documents ready.
* **Eligibility:** Review program-specific criteria before filling web options.
* **Second Phase:** Candidates not allotted seats in Phase 1 can participate in Phase 2 (October 2026).

website_content.markdown_content:
## Recruitment Overview
The Mathura Anganwadi Helper Recruitment 2026 provides a significant opportunity for women residents of Mathura to contribute to the Child Development Project (ICDS). A total of **544 vacancies** are available across various rural and urban zones.

## Key Eligibility Criteria
* **Gender:** Only women candidates are eligible to apply.
* **Residence:** Candidates **must** be residents of the same Ward/Gram Sabha where the vacancy exists.
* **Age Limit:** 18 to 35 years (as of July 01, 2026).

## Educational Qualification
* **Minimum Requirement:** Intermediate (12th) or its equivalent.
* **Merit Calculation:** The merit list will be prepared based on educational qualifications ranging from Intermediate up to Postgraduate levels.

## Selection Process
Selection is based strictly on a **Merit List** derived from educational qualifications. No written exam or interview is required. 

**Priority categories include:**
* BPL Category candidates
* Widows
* Destitute/Abandoned women

## Required Documents
* Educational certificates (12th or higher).
* Online-verifiable Income Certificate (Tehsil level).
* Online-verifiable Residence Certificate (Tehsil level).
* Category-specific certificates (Widow/Divorcee/Destitute) where applicable.

## Important Dates
* **Notification Date:** 29 January 2026
* **Application Deadline:** 13 September 2026 (Midnight)
* **Age Cut-off Date:** 01 July 2026

website_content.title: Karnataka UGCET 2026 Round 3 Fresh Option Entry
website_content.summary: KEA has opened fresh option entry for Round 3 seat allotment for UGCET 2026 across various professional courses. Eligible candidates must submit their choices between August 31 and September 3, 2026.
website_content.markdown_content:
## Overview
The **Karnataka Examinations Authority (KEA)** has announced the commencement of **Round 3 (Fresh Option Entry)** for UGCET 2026. This is a critical opportunity for candidates who have not yet secured a seat or wish to participate again after surrendering a previous allotment.

## Courses Covered
Candidates can fill options for the following professional courses:
* **Engineering** (B.E./B.Tech)
* **Architecture** (B.Arch)
* **Agriculture** and allied Farm Sciences
* **Pharmacy** (B.Pharm)
* **Nursing** and other allied health courses

## Important Dates
* **Round 3 Option Entry Opens:** August 31, 2026
* **Last Date to Fill/Lock Options:** September 3, 2026

## Who is Eligible?
* Candidates who did **not** receive a seat in Round 1 or Round 2.
* Candidates who surrendered their previously allotted seat (as per KEA rules).
* Candidates who selected **Choice 2** (retain and participate) in Round 2.

## Crucial Rule: Choice Selection
Unlike earlier rounds, Round 3 has restricted choices. **Only Choice 1 (Accept & Freeze)** is available. Candidates cannot select Choice 2 or Choice 3 in this round.

## Step-by-Step Process to Fill Options
1. Visit the official KEA counselling portal.
2. Log in using your **CET application number** and credentials.
3. Review the updated **Round 3 seat matrix**.
4. Enter preferred college and course combinations in order of priority.
5. **Lock your options** before the deadline; only the final submitted list is considered.

website_content.summary: The Maharashtra CET Cell has released the Round 4 vacant seat matrix for BBA, BMS, BCA, and BBM admissions. Candidates can check the allotment list on September 5, 2026.
website_content.markdown_content:
## Overview
The State Common Entrance Test (CET) Cell, Maharashtra is conducting the Centralised Admission Process (CAP) 2026 for admission into various professional undergraduate programmes across participating colleges in Maharashtra.

## Courses Covered
* **BBA** (Bachelor of Business Administration)
* **BMS** (Bachelor of Management Studies)
* **BCA** (Bachelor of Computer Applications)
* **BBM** (Bachelor of Business Management)
* **Integrated MBA** (First year of the four-year course)

## Important Dates for Round 4
* **Vacant Seats Displayed:** August 29, 2026
* **Allotment List Release:** September 5, 2026
* **Overall CAP Window Closing:** September 8, 2026

## Eligibility for Round 4 Participation
* Candidates who did not accept any seat allotted in Rounds 1, 2, or 3.
* Candidates who accepted a seat previously but selected the **'Betterment'** option.

## Key Instructions
* **Betterment Option:** Once a seat is accepted without choosing 'betterment', the candidate exits the CAP pool.
* **Institute Level Round:** Any seats remaining vacant after Round 4 will be transferred to the Institute Level admission round for direct filling by colleges.
* **Documentation:** Keep your Application ID and password secure for all subsequent login requirements.

website_content.title: COMEDK UGET 2026 Round 4 Seat Allotment Result
website_content.summary: COMEDK has released the final regular counselling round (Round 4) seat allotment results for UGET 2026. Allotted candidates must complete fee payment by September 3 and report to colleges by September 8, 2026.
website_content.markdown_content:
## Overview
The **Consortium of Medical, Engineering and Dental Colleges of Karnataka (COMEDK)** has announced the Round 4 seat allotment results for UGET 2026. This marks the **final regular counselling round** of the current cycle, aimed at filling 17,815 vacant engineering seats across 151 colleges.

## Key Dates
* **Allotment Result Date:** September 1, 2026
* **Decision-Making & Fee Payment:** September 1, 2026 (4:00 PM) to September 3, 2026 (2:00 PM)
* **College Reporting Deadline:** September 8, 2026 (3:00 PM)

## Allotment Status Options
* **Accept and Freeze:** Available for candidates receiving an allotment for the first time or those whose status automatically converted from 'Upgrade' in Round 3.
* **Reject and Withdraw:** Available for candidates receiving an allotment for the first time.
* **Refund:** Candidates who chose 'Reject and Upgrade' in Round 3 but received no allotment in Round 4 will exit the process and receive a refund.

## Important Rules & Penalties
* **Finality:** Round 4 is the last regular round; no seat cancellation options are available hereafter.
* **Forfeiture:** Candidates who fail to report to their allotted college will **forfeit the entire tuition and other fees** paid to COMEDK.
* **Financial Penalty:** An additional penalty of **five times the fee amount** may be applied for non-reporting after acceptance.

## How to Check Result
1. Visit the official website.
2. Click on the **Round 4 seat allotment result** link.
3. Log in with your application number and password.
4. Download the allotment letter for reporting purposes.

* **Office Assistant (Multipurpose):** 8,183 posts
* **Officer Scale-I (Assistant Manager):** 4,256 posts
* **Officer Scale-II (Specialists):** 1,047 posts
* **Officer Scale-III (Senior Manager):** 220 posts

* **Application Start Date:** 01.09.2026
* **Application Deadline:** 21.09.2026
* **Preliminary Exam:** November/December 2026
* **Main Examination:** December 2026/February 2027
* **Provisional Allotment:** February/March 2027

### 🎓 Eligibility & Age Limit
**1. Office Assistant / Officer Scale-I**
* **Qualification:** Bachelor's degree in any discipline from a recognized university.
* **Age:** 18-28 years (Office Assistant) | 18-30 years (Officer Scale-I).

**2. Officer Scale-II**
* **Qualification:** Bachelor's degree with 50% marks + relevant experience (1-2 years depending on specialization like IT, Law, CA, Marketing, Agriculture).
* **Age:** 21-32 years.

**3. Officer Scale-III**
* **Qualification:** Bachelor's degree with 50% marks + minimum 5 years experience as an officer in a bank/financial institution.

* **All Other Categories:** ₹850

website_content.title: TNPSC Combined Technical Services Examination (Interview Posts) Recruitment 2026
website_content.summary: TNPSC has announced 170 vacancies for 31 different technical and professional posts across various government departments. The application window closes on October 6, 2026.
website_content.markdown_content:
## TNPSC CTSE Interview Posts Recruitment 2026

The Tamil Nadu Public Service Commission (TNPSC) has released Notification No. 8/2026 for the **Combined Technical Services Examination (CTSE) - Interview Posts**. This is a premium opportunity for technical professionals to join various Government departments and Public Sector Undertakings (PSUs) in Tamil Nadu.

### 📌 Key Highlights
* **Total Vacancies:** 170 Posts
* **Total Post Types:** 31 Different Designations
* **Selection Process:** Written Examination (Paper I & Paper II) followed by an Interview.
* **Application Mode:** Online Only

### 📅 Important Dates
* **Notification Date:** 31.08.2026
* **Application Start Date:** 07.09.2026
* **Last Date to Apply:** 06.10.2026 (11:59 PM)
* **Correction Window:** 10.10.2026 to 12.10.2026

### 🎓 Eligibility & Qualifications
Since there are 31 different posts, eligibility varies. Key requirements include:
* **Engineering/Tech:** B.E/B.Tech (Mechanical, Electrical, CSE, IT, ECE, Textile, etc.) for roles like Assistant Manager and Senior Officer.
* **Finance/Accounts:** CA/ICWA/MBA (Finance) for Assistant General Manager (Finance) and Accounts Officer.
* **Veterinary/Medical:** B.V.Sc or M.V.Sc for Veterinary Assistant Surgeon and Research Assistant.
* **Specialized:** Masters in Psychology, Library Science, Statistics, or Traditional Architecture for respective roles.
* **Experience:** Certain senior roles (Unit Head, AGM) require 5 to 20 years of relevant industry experience.

### 💼 Post-wise Vacancy Breakdown (Major Posts)
* **Veterinary Assistant Surgeon:** 79
* **Senior Officer (Technical):** 10
* **Senior Entomologist:** 13
* **English/Tamil Reporters:** 11
* **Assistant Manager (Various):** 9
* **Other Specialist Posts:** 50+ distributed across 20+ roles

### 💰 Salary
Selected candidates will be placed according to the **TN Govt Pay Matrix Levels** (ranging from Level 27 to Level 30 depending on the post).

website_content.summary: CONCOR (Navratna CPSE) is hiring 77 professionals for Management Trainee and Assistant Officer roles across various disciplines. The application window closes on September 30, 2026.
website_content.markdown_content:
## CONCOR Recruitment 2026 Overview
Container Corporation of India Limited (CONCOR), a Navratna CPSE under the Ministry of Railways, has released employment notification 05/2026 for direct recruitment of technical and administrative professionals.

### 📅 Important Dates
* **Application Start Date:** 31 August 2026 (10:00 AM)
* **Application Last Date:** 30 September 2026 (11:55 PM)
* **Eligibility Reckoning Date:** 31 August 2026

### 📋 Vacancy Details
Total Posts: **77**
* **Management Trainee (MT):** 45 Posts (Commercial, Accounts, Technical, MIS, Civil, Personnel & Admin)
* **Assistant Officer (AO):** 32 Posts (Commercial, Accounts, Technical, MIS, Civil)

### 🎓 Eligibility Criteria
**1. Management Trainee (Age: 18–28 Years)**
* **MT/CO:** Graduate (55%) + MBA/PG Degree in Marketing/Logistics/Supply Chain (60%)
* **MT/FA:** Graduate (55%) + Qualified Chartered Accountant (CA)
* **MT/FA/CS:** Graduate (55%) + Qualified Company Secretary (CS)
* **MT/TH:** B.E./B.Tech in Mechanical/Electrical/Electronics (60%)
* **MT/MIS:** B.Tech/BE (CS/IT) or MCA/M.Sc(IT) (60%)
* **MT/CE:** B.E./B.Tech in Civil Engineering (60%)
* **MT/P&A:** Graduate (55%) + MBA/MSW in HRM/Personnel Management (60%)

**2. Assistant Officer (Age: 18–32 Years)**
* **AO/CO:** Graduate (50%) + 4 years experience (reduced to 2 years with specific diplomas)
* **AO/FA:** B.Com (50%) + 4 years experience (reduced to 2 years for CA/CMA Inter)
* **AO/TH:** Diploma/Degree in Mech/Elec/Electronics (50%) + relevant experience
* **AO/MIS:** Graduate with PGDCA/BCA/B.Sc CS (50%) + relevant experience
* **AO/CE:** B.E./B.Tech/Diploma in Civil (50%) + relevant experience

### 💰 Salary & Benefits
* **Management Trainee:** Pay Scale ₹50,000-1,60,000 | **Approx CTC: ₹20.11 Lakhs p.a.**
* **Assistant Officer:** Pay Scale ₹40,000-1,36,000 | **Approx CTC: ₹16.09 Lakhs p.a.**
* *Note: MTs are absorbed into Assistant Manager grade (E1) after 1 year of training.*

### ⚙️ Selection Process
* **Management Trainee:** CBT $ightarrow$ Group Discussion (GD) and/or Interview
* **Assistant Officer:** Selection purely based on **CBT performance** (No GD/Interview)

**CBT Pattern:** 100 Questions | 100 Marks | 90 Minutes | Negative Marking: 0.25

### 💳 Application Fee
* **MT Posts:** ₹750 + GST (UR/OBC/EWS) | SC/ST/PwBD/ESM: Exempted
* **AO Posts:** ₹500 + GST (UR/OBC/EWS) | SC/ST/PwBD/ESM: Exempted

website_content.markdown_content:
## PSSSB ADA Final Answer Key 2026

The **Punjab Subordinate Services Selection Board (PSSSB)** has officially published the final answer keys for the **Assistant District Attorney (ADA)** recruitment (Advt. No. 09 of 2026) for the Department of Justice, Government of Punjab.

**Exam Overview:**
* **Post Name:** Assistant District Attorney (ADA)
* **Written Exam Date:** 02 August 2026
* **Answer Key Release Date:** 31 August 2026
* **Sets Released:** Set A, Set B, Set C, and Set D

## Important Dates
* **Written Examination:** 02/08/2026
* **Final Answer Key Release:** 31/08/2026

## How to Download the Final Answer Key
1. Visit the official PSSSB portal.
2. Navigate to the **'Answer Keys'** or **'Notices'** section on the homepage.
3. Locate the link for **'Final answer key of Written Examination'** for Assistant District Attorney (Advt. No. 09 of 2026).
4. Select the PDF corresponding to your exam set (**Set A, B, C, or D**) as mentioned on your admit card.
5. Save the PDF and cross-verify your responses.

## Key Instructions for Candidates
* **Verify Set:** Ensure you are checking the key for your specific question booklet set; keys are not interchangeable.
* **Final Status:** This is the post-objection final key; no further objection window is currently mentioned.
* **Official Source:** Only trust PDFs downloaded from the official board website.

website_content.markdown_content:
## Recruitment Overview
The Panipat Urban Co-operative Bank Ltd. (Multi State Bank) has announced vacancies for several professional roles on a **contract basis**. These positions will be stationed across Kaithal, Jagadhari, Yamunanagar, Panchkula, Chandigarh, Ludhiana, and other proposed branches.

## Vacancy Details
| Post Name | Total Posts | Educational Qualification | Experience Required |
| :--- | :---: | :--- | :--- |
| **Senior Accountant** | 3 | B.Com/BBA/BCA/MBA (Finance & Marketing) | Min. 7 Years in Banking |
| **Junior Accountant** | 3 | B.Com/BBA/BCA/MBA (Finance & Marketing) | Min. 5 Years in Banking |
| **Senior Clerk** | 3 | B.Com/BBA/BCA/MBA (Finance & Marketing) | Min. 2 Years in Banking |
| **Clerk-cum-Cashier/Field Supervisor** | 10 | B.Com/BBA/BCA/B.Tech/B.E (CSE/IT)/M.Com/MBA | As applicable |

## Key Highlights
* **Application Fee:** Nil (Free of cost)
* **Selection Process:** Personal Interview, Assessment, or Written Test based on bank requirements.
* **Application Mode:** Offline (Handwritten application in a sealed envelope).

## Important Dates
* **Application Start Date:** 1 September 2026
* **Application Last Date:** 15 September 2026 (up to 5:00 p.m.)

## Documents Required
* Handwritten Application Form
* Updated Curriculum Vitae (CV)
* Educational Certificates (Photocopies)

website_content.title: Gujarat NEET UG Counselling 2026 Round 2 Registration
website_content.summary: ACPUGMEC has opened Round 2 registration for MBBS and BDS admissions under the Gujarat state quota for eligible NEET UG 2026 candidates.
website_content.markdown_content:
## Overview
The Admission Committee for Professional Undergraduate Medical Educational Courses (ACPUGMEC), Gandhinagar, has commenced the **Round 2 Registration** process for MBBS and BDS admissions. This round is specifically designed for candidates seeking seats under the Gujarat state quota (85%).

## Eligibility Criteria
Round 2 is open to the following categories of NEET UG 2026 qualified candidates:
* **New Applicants:** Candidates who did not participate/register in Round 1.
* **Round 1 Participants:** Candidates who registered in Round 1 but were not allotted a seat.
* **Non-Freezers:** Candidates who were allotted a seat in Round 1 but chose not to freeze or accept it.

## Important Dates
* **Round 2 Registration Start Date:** 1 September 2026
* **Other Dates:** Please monitor the official portal for the provisional merit list, choice filling, and seat allotment schedules.

## How to Register
1. **PIN Purchase:** Visit the official portal and purchase a registration PIN (skip if you already have one from Round 1).
2. **Online Application:** Log in using your PIN and NEET UG/Class 12 details to fill in personal and domicile information.
3. **Document Upload:** Upload all required academic and category documents.
4. **Verification Slot:** Select a preferred Help Centre and a time slot for in-person document verification.
5. **Physical Verification:** Visit the designated Help Centre with original documents to collect the signed Registration Acknowledgement Slip.

## Key Instructions
* **Mandatory Verification:** Online registration alone is not sufficient; in-person document verification is compulsory for participation.
* **Choice Filling:** Candidates must complete the choice filling process in every round to be considered for seat allotment.
* **Security:** Keep your PIN and password confidential until the entire admission and refund process is complete.

website_content.title: UP Board Exam 2027 Registration Update (Class 10 & 12)
website_content.summary: UPMSP has extended the registration deadlines for students appearing in the 2027 High School and Intermediate board examinations. Schools must now complete fee deposits and data uploads by the revised September deadlines.
website_content.markdown_content:
## Overview
The **Uttar Pradesh Madhyamik Shiksha Parishad (UPMSP)** has announced an extension for the registration process for the academic session 2026-27. This extension provides affiliated schools additional time to manage fee collection, treasury deposits, and student data verification.

## Revised Registration Schedule 2027
| Activity | Revised Deadline |
| :--- | :--- |
| **Fee Collection from Students** | September 1, 2026 |
| **Deposit Fee in Treasury** | September 5, 2026 |
| **Data Upload & Correction Window** | September 6 to September 11, 2026 |
| **Final Submission to DIOS Office** | September 30, 2026 |

## Eligibility Criteria
Registration is mandatory for the following categories:
* **Regular Students**: Currently enrolled in Class 10 or 12 in UPMSP-affiliated schools.
* **Private Candidates**: Those meeting the specific board eligibility guidelines.
* **Compartment/Improvement Candidates**: As permitted by the board rules.

## School-Level Registration Process
1. **Fee Collection**: Schools collect exam fees from students.
2. **Treasury Deposit**: The head of the institution deposits fees via challan.
3. **Data Upload**: Academic details and challan info are uploaded to the official portal.
4. **Verification & Correction**: Principals verify data; corrections are made during the window (ending Sept 11).
5. **DIOS Submission**: Final lists and documents are submitted to the District Inspector of Schools.

## Important Instructions
* **Mandatory Process**: Only registered students will receive admit cards.
* **Accuracy**: No corrections will be accepted after the window closes.
* **Student Role**: Students must confirm with their respective schools that their details (Name, DOB, Subjects) are uploaded correctly.

website_content.title: PGIMER Chandigarh Recruitment 2026: 60 Group A, B & C Vacancies
website_content.summary: PGIMER Chandigarh is inviting online applications for 60 posts across its main campus and Sangrur Satellite Centre. Applications are open from September 3 to October 19, 2026.
website_content.markdown_content:
## Recruitment Overview
The Postgraduate Institute of Medical Education & Research (PGIMER), Chandigarh, has announced direct recruitment for **60 vacancies**. The positions are spread across PGIMER Chandigarh (Group C) and the PGI Satellite Centre, Sangrur (Group A, B, and C).

## Vacancy Details
### PGIMER Chandigarh (57 Posts - Group C)
* **Multi Tasking Staff (Sanitation) Grade-III:** 54 Posts
* **Library Attendant Grade-I:** 1 Post
* **Animal Attendant:** 1 Post
* **Barber:** 1 Post

### PGI Satellite Centre, Sangrur (3 Posts)
* **Medical Officer (Group A):** 1 Post
* **Computer Programmer (Group B):** 1 Post
* **Pharmacist Grade-II (Group C):** 1 Post

## Eligibility Criteria
* **Medical Officer:** Medical qualification as per IMC Act 1956 + State Medical Council registration.
* **Computer Programmer:** Master's in Stats/Maths/Physics/CS or Engineering degree with relevant experience.
* **Pharmacist Grade-II:** Matriculation + Diploma in Pharmacy (Registered Pharmacist).
* **Library Attendant:** Matric with Science + Diploma in Library Science + 1 year experience.
* **MTS/Animal Attendant/Barber:** Matriculation or equivalent.

## Important Dates
* **Registration Starts:** 03.09.2026
* **Application Deadline:** 19.10.2026

## Selection Process
* **Group A:** Computer Based Test (CBT) followed by an Interview.
* **Group B & C:** Selection based solely on CBT merit.
* **Exam Pattern:** MCQs with 0.25 negative marking. CBT is conducted in English only.

## Application Fee
* **General/OBC/EWS:** ₹1,500
* **SC/ST:** ₹800
* **PwBD:** Exempted

website_content.markdown_content:
## Overview
The **Department of Medical Education and Research (DMER), Haryana**, in collaboration with **Pt. B.D. Sharma University of Health Sciences (UHS), Rohtak**, has issued the Revised Tentative Seat Matrix for admission to MBBS and BDS courses for the year 2026.

* **Courses Covered:** MBBS and BDS

## Category Breakdown
The seat matrix includes specific allocations for:
* **OPEN_CAT:** Open/General Category
* **OSC:** Reserved vertical category (as per DMER Haryana)
* **SC_DEPRIVED:** Scheduled Caste (Deprived)
* **BCA:** Backward Class (A)
* **PWBD:** Persons with Benchmark Disabilities
* **ESM_FF:** Ex-Servicemen / Freedom Fighter dependents

* **Tentative Nature:** This is a *Revised-Tentative* matrix; final changes may be uploaded before seat allocation.
* **Choice Filling:** Candidates are officially advised to fill the **maximum number of choices** to optimize their allocation chances.
* **Special Note:** Seat counts for Al-Falah College are subject to a pending High Court case and may change.

website_content.title: DNH & DD AYUSH Recruitment 2026: Apply for 30 Medical & Technical Posts
website_content.summary: The DMHS, U.T. of Dadra & Nagar Haveli and Daman & Diu is recruiting for 30 short-term contract positions under the National AYUSH Mission. Eligible candidates across India can apply by September 12, 2026.
website_content.markdown_content:
## DNH & DD AYUSH Recruitment 2026 Overview

The Directorate of Medical & Health Services (DMHS), U.T. of Dadra & Nagar Haveli and Daman & Diu has announced vacancies for the **100-bedded Ayurvedic Hospital at Pati, Silvassa**. These positions are on a short-term contract basis under the National AYUSH Mission.

### 📌 Vacancy Details
| Post Name | Total Vacancies | Monthly Remuneration |
| :--- | :---: | :--- |
| **Senior Medical Officer** | 1 | Rs. 1,06,966/- |
| **Panchakarma Technician (Senior)** | 9 | Rs. 37,500/- |
| **Panchakarma Technician (Medium)** | 9 | Rs. 31,250/- |
| **Panchakarma Technician (Junior)** | 10 | Rs. 25,000/- |
| **Yoga Instructor** | 1 | Rs. 28,000/- |

### 🎓 Eligibility Criteria

*   **Senior Medical Officer:** BAMS with MD/MS in specialized fields (Panchakarma, Shalya Tantra, etc.) + Minimum 5 years experience (10 years desirable).
*   **Panchakarma Technicians:** Diploma/Certificate in Panchakarma. Experience required based on level (Senior: 10 yrs, Medium: 5 yrs, Junior: None specified).
*   **Yoga Instructor:** Diploma in Yoga Science (D.Y.Sc.) or Diploma in Yoga Therapy (DYT).

### ⚙️ Selection Process
*   **No Written Exam:** Selection is based **solely on an interview**.
*   **Shortlisting:** Candidates will be screened based on their applications and notified via email/telephone 7 days prior to the interview.

### 📅 Important Dates
*   **Advertisement Date:** 29 August 2026
*   **Application Deadline:** 12 September 2026

### 📝 How to Apply
1.  Download the prescribed application format from the official website.
2.  Attach self-attested photocopies of educational and experience certificates.
3.  Submit the completed application via **Hard Copy** to the Office of the Mission Director, Silvassa, or via **Email** to the official recruitment address.
4.  Ensure the application reaches the authority by **12 September 2026**.

## WB NEET UG 2026 Round 1 Allotment Overview

The West Bengal Medical Counselling Committee (WBMCC) has officially announced the **Round 1 Seat Allotment Result** for candidates seeking admission to MBBS and BDS courses under the state quota in government and private medical/dental colleges of West Bengal.

## 📅 Important Dates
* **Result Release Date:** August 31, 2026
* **Institute Reporting Window:** September 1 to September 5, 2026
* **Registration Window (Completed):** August 13 to 16, 2026
* **Choice Filling (Completed):** August 25 to 27, 2026

To check the allotment result, candidates must have:
* Qualified the **NEET UG 2026** examination.
* Completed the WBMCC registration process.
* Met the **West Bengal domicile** and category norms.
* Participated in the Round 1 choice filling process.

## 🛠️ Steps to Check Allotment Result

## ⚠️ Mandatory Reporting Instructions
Allotted candidates must physically report to their assigned college between **September 1 and September 5, 2026**. Please ensure you carry:
* A printout of the **provisional allotment letter**.
* All **original documents** for verification.

website_content.title: ICAR-NRC Banana Apprentice Recruitment 2026
website_content.summary: ICAR-NRC Banana invites online applications for 20 Graduate and Technician Apprentice positions for the 2026 session. Eligible candidates must apply via the NATS portal by September 17, 2026.
website_content.markdown_content:
## Recruitment Overview
ICAR – National Research Centre for Banana (NRCB) is offering a one-year training opportunity under the Apprentices (Amendment) Act, 1973. This is a merit-based selection process for fresh graduates and diploma holders.

## Vacancy Details
**Total Posts: 20**

* **Graduate Apprentices (18 Posts):**
    * B.Sc (Life Science): 6 Posts
    * B.Sc (Agriculture/Horticulture): 4 Posts
    * B.Sc (Biotechnology/Botany/BCA/Computer Science): 2 Posts each
    * B.Sc (Biochemistry/Chemistry): 1 Post each
* **Technician Apprentices (2 Posts):**
    * Diploma (Agriculture/Horticulture): 2 Posts

## Eligibility Criteria
* **Educational Qualification:** Degree or Diploma in the relevant discipline from a UGC-approved university/institute.
* **Passing Year:** Must have passed in **2022, 2023, 2024, 2025, or 2026**.
* **Experience:** Candidates with 1 year or more of work experience or those who have already completed an apprenticeship are **NOT eligible**.
* **Mandatory Requirement:** Must be registered on the **NATS Portal**.

## Stipend
* **Graduate Apprentices:** ₹12,300 per month
* **Technician Apprentices:** ₹10,900 per month

## Selection Process
* **Mode:** Purely based on **Merit** (Aggregate marks of the qualifying degree/diploma).
* **Verification:** Shortlisted candidates will be called for certificate verification at the Tiruchirappalli center.

## Important Dates
* **Application Start Date:** 27 August 2026
* **Application Last Date:** 17 September 2026

website_content.markdown_content:
## UPCATET Round 3 Seat Allotment Overview

The **UPCATET Round 3 Seat Allotment** is the critical third stage of the counselling process for the Uttar Pradesh Combined Agriculture and Technology Entrance Test 2026. This offline round is designed to fill the remaining vacant seats after the first two rounds of allotment.

### 📌 Key Highlights
* **Conducting Body:** Banda University of Agriculture and Technology (BUAT), Banda
* **Mode of Round 3:** Offline (Includes in-person document verification)
* **Result Date:** August 30, 2026
* **Purpose:** Allocation of seats left vacant due to withdrawals, upgrades, or non-reporting.

### 📅 Important Dates
* **UPCATET UG Exam:** June 17, 2026
* **UPCATET PG Exam:** June 18, 2026
* **Round 1 Result:** July 26, 2026
* **Round 2 Result:** August 8, 2026
* **Round 3 Result:** August 30, 2026

### 🛠️ How to Check Your Allotment Status
1. Visit the official counselling dashboard.
2. Click on the **Round 3 Seat Allotment/Result** link.
3. Log in using your **Application Number** and **Password/DOB**.
4. View your allotted university, programme, and category.
5. Download and print the **Provisional Allotment Letter**.

### ⚠️ Critical Instructions
* **Mandatory Reporting:** Failure to report to the allotted university within the deadline will lead to automatic cancellation of the seat.
* **Offline Verification:** Since this is an offline round, ensure all original documents and a printed copy of the allotment letter are ready before visiting the campus.
* **Further Rounds:** Candidates not allotted a seat in Round 3 should monitor the portal for potential spot or special rounds.

website_content.title: Karnataka High Court District Judge (LDCE) Recruitment 2026
website_content.summary: The High Court of Karnataka has announced 79 vacancies for District Judge via Limited Departmental Competitive Examination. This internal promotion is open exclusively to eligible serving Senior Civil Judges by September 15, 2026.
website_content.markdown_content:
## Overview
The High Court of Karnataka is inviting applications for the post of **District Judge** through a Limited Departmental Competitive Examination (LDCE) as per Rule 4-B of the Karnataka Judicial Service (Recruitment) (Amendment) Rules, 2025. 

**Important Note:** This is an internal promotional recruitment and is **NOT open to the general public**.

## Key Recruitment Details
* **Total Vacancies:** 79 (Subject to Supreme Court ruling in WP(C) No. 1022/1989)
* **Post Name:** District Judge (25% LDCE Category)
* **Selection Process:** Written Examination followed by a Viva-voce
* **Application Mode:** Online only

## Eligibility Criteria
Candidates must be serving Senior Civil Judges and satisfy the following as of 28.08.2026:
* **Service as SCJ:** Minimum 3 years of service as a Senior Civil Judge.
* **Total Service:** Minimum 7 years of combined service in the cadre of Civil Judge and Senior Civil Judge.
* **Age:** Minimum 35 years of age.
* **Attempts:** A maximum of 3 attempts are allowed for this LDCE.

## Important Dates
* **Notification Date:** 28 August 2026
* **Application Deadline:** 15 September 2026, 11:59 PM
* **Eligibility Reckoning Date:** 28 August 2026

## Application Process
1. Visit the official portal at `judiciary.karnataka.gov.in`.
2. Complete the online application form with a valid mobile number and email ID.
3. Upload a recent passport-size photo (White background, max 50KB, JPG).
4. Upload a signature (Black ballpoint pen on white paper, max 25KB, JPG).
5. Submit the application before the deadline.

website_content.title: DRDO NPOL Junior Research Fellow (JRF) Recruitment 2026
website_content.summary: NPOL, a laboratory of DRDO, is inviting eligible candidates for the position of Junior Research Fellow (JRF) across seven disciplines. Selection will be conducted via a walk-in interview on 10 October 2026 in Kochi.
website_content.markdown_content:
## Recruitment Overview
The **Naval Physical and Oceanographic Laboratory (NPOL)**, under the **Defence Research & Development Organisation (DRDO)**, Ministry of Defence, has announced recruitment for **Junior Research Fellows (JRF)**. This is a prestigious opportunity to contribute to defence research in various technical disciplines.

## Vacancy Details
Vacancies are distributed across seven disciplines. While Mechanical Engineering has confirmed seats, others are listed as anticipated based on requirements:
* **Mechanical Engineering:** 04 Vacancies
* **Computer Science & Engineering:** Anticipated
* **Chemical/Rubber/Polymer/Nanotechnology/Materials Science:** Anticipated
* **Opto Electronics:** Anticipated
* **Electrical/Electronics/Instrumentation Engineering:** Anticipated
* **Physics:** Anticipated
* **Oceanography/Ocean Technology/Meteorology:** Anticipated

## Eligibility Criteria
* **Educational Qualification:** 
    * **Engineering Streams:** 1st Division B.E/B.Tech with valid GATE OR 1st Division M.E/M.Tech.
    * **Basic Sciences:** 1st Division Post Graduate degree with valid NET/GATE.
* **Age Limit:** Maximum **28 years** as of the date of the walk-in interview.
* **Other:** Candidates with foreign degrees must provide an equivalence certificate from AIU, Delhi.

## Fellowship & Duration
* **Stipend:** ₹37,000/- per month plus House Rent Allowance (HRA) as per rules.
* **Tenure:** Initially for **2 years**, extendable based on performance and rules.

## Selection Process
Selection is based entirely on a **Walk-in Interview**. No separate online application is required. 

## Important Date & Venue
* **Interview Date:** 10 October 2026 (Saturday)
* **Reporting Time:** 09:30 hrs
* **Venue:** Bhavan's Varuna Vidyalaya, NPOL Campus, Thrikkakara P.O., Kochi, Kerala – 682021.

website_content.title: UKSSSC Group C Recruitment 2026 Notification
website_content.summary: UKSSSC is recruiting for 553 Group C posts across various government departments in Uttarakhand. Eligible candidates with a 12th-pass qualification can apply online by October 7, 2026.
website_content.markdown_content:
## UKSSSC Group C Recruitment 2026 Overview

The Uttarakhand Subordinate Service Selection Commission (UKSSSC) has announced direct recruitment for **553 vacancies** in Group 'C' posts. This is a massive opportunity for candidates seeking stable government employment in Uttarakhand.

### 📌 Key Vacancies
* **Administrative Roles:** Junior Assistant, Senior Assistant, Computer Assistant, Registration Clerk.
* **Technical Roles:** Computer Operator, Telephone Operator, Assistant Mineral Supervisor.
* **Field Roles:** Survey Lekhpal, Land Acquisition Amin/Inspector.
* **Others:** Store Keeper, Grihamata, Ahalmad & Cashier.

### 🎓 Eligibility Criteria
* **Education:** Intermediate (Class 12) or equivalent from a recognized board.
* **Typing Skill:** Minimum Hindi typing speed of **4000 KDPH** on a computer is mandatory for most posts.
* **Special Requirements:** Some posts require MS Office knowledge or specific diplomas (e.g., Computer Operator, Store Keeper).

### 📅 Important Dates
* **Application Start Date:** 08 September 2026
* **Application Last Date:** 07 October 2026
* **Correction Window:** 12 October to 14 October 2026
* **Written Exam Date:** 15 November 2026 (Tentative)

### 🔞 Age Limit (as of 01.07.2026)
* **General Range:** 18 to 42 years.
* **Specific Posts:** Minimum 21 years for certain Junior Assistant and Store Keeper roles.
* **Relaxation:** 5 years for SC/ST/OBC (Non-Creamy Layer) and 10 years for PwBD candidates.

### 💳 Application Fee
* **UR / OBC:** ₹300
* **SC / ST / EWS / PwBD:** ₹150
* **Orphan Candidates:** Exempted (₹0)

### 📝 Selection Process
1. **Written Exam:** 100 Objective questions (100 marks) covering Hindi, General Knowledge, and Uttarakhand GK. Negative marking: 0.25 per wrong answer.
2. **Typing Test:** Qualifying stage for those who clear the written exam.

website_content.markdown_content:
## APSSB Uniformed Services Combined Examination 2026 Final Result

The Arunachal Pradesh Staff Selection Board (APSSB), Itanagar, has released the **Final Result Notice** (Notice No. APSSB-13/6/2026/1342) for the Special Recruitment Drive for Uniformed Services Combined Examination 2026.

### 📌 Posts Covered
The final result includes provisional recommendations for the following positions:
* **Special Tiger Guard** (under STPF)
* **Fireman**
* **Constable** (Indian Reserve Battalion - IRBn)
* **Constable Band** (IRBn)
* **Constable Civil Police** (Male & Female)

### 📅 Important Dates
* **Advertisement Issued:** 13.03.2026
* **Provisional Result:** 20.06.2026
* **Document Verification:** 29.06.2026 to 03.07.2026
* **PST, PET & Trade Test:** 13.07.2026 to 26.07.2026
* **Medical Fitness Test:** Started from 10.08.2026
* **Final Result Declaration:** 01.09.2026

### 🛠️ Selection Process
The final selection has been determined based on the **Merit-cum-preference** of candidates who successfully completed the following stages:
1. Document Verification (DV)
2. Physical Standard Test (PST)
3. Physical Efficiency Test (PET)
4. Trade Test
5. Medical Fitness Test

### ⚠️ Important Instructions
* **Provisional Nature:** This result is a provisional recommendation and does not guarantee a final appointment.
* **Verification:** Final appointment is subject to independent verification of character, antecedents, and eligibility by the Appointing Authority.
* **Joining Details:** Specific joining dates and reporting locations have not been mentioned; candidates must monitor the official website for further communication from the Home, STPF, or Forest Departments.
